papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：严格正定的张量重构方法（如对数构象法）仍可能因三种机制（熵偏差、对数扰动放大、应力功与熵变量不兼容）导致非物理行为。作者提出了一种“熵兼容重构”原理，并基于最小阻尼熵约束给出了修正的对数重构方法，该方法能保证离散自由能平衡的兼容性。；创新点：首次明确指出并系统分析了在粘弹性流动模拟中，仅保证张量正定性不足以确保与离散自由能平衡的兼容性。提出了一个全新的“熵兼容重构”原则，并给出了一个具体的、局部、正定、可通过二分法计算且与现有时间步进方案兼容的修正对数重构方法。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合数值诊断。理论层面：识别了三种导致非物理行为的重构机制，并基于熵兼容原理和凸性分析推导了修正重构方法，证明了其存在性、凸性、自由能估计等数学性质。数值层面：通过可重复的诊断测试，比较了对数、平方根和线性重构方法，验证了预测的熵缺陷、功缺陷、应力-力误差以及高魏森伯格数下的累积效应。

papers.title: Mobility Heterogeneity in a 2D Gaussian Lattice Polymer: A Dynamic Monte Carlo Study
papers.abstract: We study mobility heterogeneity in a two-dimensional Gaussian lattice polymer using dynamic Monte Carlo simulations. The polymer dynamics is generated from a local three-monomer move dictionary, which explicitly enumerates allowed bond-preserving updates on a square lattice. As a homogeneous benchmark, this dictionary reproduces the expected Rouse-like behavior of an ideal chain, including the crossover in monomer mean-squared displacement (MSD) and the center-of-mass diffusion scaling $D_{\rm cm} \sim N^{-1}$. We then introduce a two-block version of the model in which the two halves of the chain are updated with different attempt rates, $ω_A$ and $ω_B$, while the local move dictionary remains unchanged. For $ρ=ω_A/ω_B>1$, the more frequently updated block shows a larger block-resolved MSD at early and intermediate times, producing a positive normalized MSD asymmetry. However, numerical measurements show that the center-of-mass diffusion coefficient remains consistent with $D_{\rm cm} \sim N^{-1}$ for all rate ratios studied. We invoke a simple coarse-grained Rouse argument to explain this result analytically. In this minimal Gaussian setting, rate-induced mobility heterogeneity modifies internal relaxation without changing the Rouse scaling of center-of-mass transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：dynamic Monte Carlo simulations、数值测量、粗粒化Rouse理论分析）；研究对象：二维高斯晶格聚合物中的迁移率异质性（mobility heterogeneity），具体通过引入不同更新速率的双嵌段聚合物模型进行研究。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维高斯晶格聚合物中，通过局部三单体移动字典引入的速率诱导迁移率异质性会改变内部松弛动力学，但不会改变质心输运的Rouse标度行为（\(D_{\rm cm} \sim N^{-1}\)）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维高斯晶格聚合物中，通过局部三单体移动字典引入的速率诱导迁移率异质性会改变内部松弛动力学，但不会改变质心输运的Rouse标度行为（\(D_{\rm cm} \sim N^{-1}\)）。；创新点：在最小高斯晶格聚合物模型中，系统研究了速率诱导的迁移率异质性对单体均方位移（MSD）不对称性和质心扩散标度的影响，并利用简单粗粒化Rouse模型解析解释了质心扩散标度不变性。
papers.method_zh: 动态蒙特卡洛模拟（dynamic Monte Carlo simulations），使用局部三单体移动字典（local three-monomer move dictionary）在正方晶格上生成聚合物动力学；通过设置不同尝试更新速率（\(\omega_A\)和\(\omega_B\)）构建双嵌段模型；采用粗粒化Rouse论证进行解析分析。

papers.title: SPLIT-PINN: Separable Probability Learning Technique via Physics-Informed Neural Networks for High-Dimensional Probabilistic Modeling
papers.abstract: We present a probabilistic modeling framework for incorporating small-scale spatial heterogeneity into macroscopic descriptions of material behavior for polycrystalline metallic materials. Spatially heterogeneous material state fields are represented using probability density functions (PDFs), providing a principled statistical description of microstructural variability and state evolution across different computational polycrystalline realizations. The framework is built on the inverse identification of a probabilistic transport model, formulated as a Liouville equation with an unknown drift term. To enable accurate, stable, and interpretable inference of this drift field in high-dimensional, transport-dominated settings, we develop a Separable Probability Learning Technique via Physics-Informed Neural Networks (SPLIT-PINN). This method incorporates a marginal-correction drift decomposition, orthogonality constraints, and residual-based adaptive training to enhance well-posedness, numerical stability, and physical consistency without imposing restrictive parametric assumptions. Using SPLIT-PINN, the drift field governing the temporal evolution of joint state PDFs is inferred directly from data. After benchmark validation, the framework is applied to physical computational datasets describing the evolution of polycrystalline microstructural states, including von Mises stress, dislocation density, and equivalent plastic strain rate. The learned Liouville model, trained on a single dataset, is subsequently used in forward predictions of the temporal evolution of joint and marginal PDFs for multiple unseen polycrystal realizations. Quantitative comparisons with reference PDFs demonstrate that the proposed framework yields accurate and robust probabilistic predictions and generalizes effectively across datasets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“probabilistic modeling framework”、“inverse identification”、“Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINN)”、“computational datasets”。；研究对象：多晶金属材料中微观结构空间异质性的概率建模，具体涉及von Mises应力、位错密度和等效塑性应变率等微观状态场的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于物理信息神经网络的分离概率学习技术（SPLIT-PINN），能够从数据中准确推断控制多晶微观状态联合概率密度函数时间演化的漂移场，并在未见过的多晶实现上实现鲁棒的向前概率预测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于物理信息神经网络的分离概率学习技术（SPLIT-PINN），能够从数据中准确推断控制多晶微观状态联合概率密度函数时间演化的漂移场，并在未见过的多晶实现上实现鲁棒的向前概率预测。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于Liouville方程的概率输运模型，通过物理信息神经网络（PINN）进行逆问题求解，推断未知的漂移场。具体技术包括：边际校正漂移分解、正交性约束和残差自适应训练。

papers.title: Variational low-energy subspaces for chemically accurate excited states
papers.abstract: Accurate electronic excited states are essential for photochemistry, spectroscopy and non-adiabatic molecular dynamics, but high-level calculations often scale steeply and require prior knowledge of the target state's character or symmetry. Here we show that variational excited-state optimization can be reformulated as an iterated ground-state-like problem for a low-energy subspace of the electronic Hamiltonian. Applying this variational principle to non-orthogonal Slater determinants leads to EXIDOS, an automatic method for excited state calculations controlled only by the number of states and determinants per state. EXIDOS optimizes multiple excited states simultaneously, without explicit orthogonality constraints or imposed spin and point-group symmetries. Benchmarks against FCI and state-of-the-art quantum chemistry methods show chemical accuracy for a multitude of states in N$_2$ and CO, charge-transfer states in HCl, Rydberg states in NH$_3$, double excitations and extended potential-energy curves in C$_2$, and avoided crossings and conical intersections in ethylene. These results establish EXIDOS as a low-scaling, fully variational route to chemically accurate excited states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：variational principle、non-orthogonal Slater determinants、benchmarks against FCI and quantum chemistry methods。；研究对象：电子激发态，具体测试体系包括N₂、CO、HCl、NH₃、C₂和乙烯等分子中的各类激发态（如电荷转移态、里德伯态、双激发态、势能曲线、避免交叉和圆锥交叉等）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种将变分激发态优化重新表述为低能子空间迭代基态问题的方法（EXIDOS），可在无需显式正交约束或对称性先验知识的情况下，同时优化多个激发态，并达到化学精度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种将变分激发态优化重新表述为低能子空间迭代基态问题的方法（EXIDOS），可在无需显式正交约束或对称性先验知识的情况下，同时优化多个激发态，并达到化学精度。；创新点：将变分激发态优化转化为迭代的基态类问题，避免了传统方法中显式正交约束和对称性先验知识的需求，实现了低标度、全变分的化学精度激发态计算。
papers.method_zh: 基于非正交Slater行列式的变分激发态优化方法（EXIDOS），通过将激发态计算转化为低能子空间的迭代基态问题，仅由状态数和每状态行列式数控制计算，并与全组态相互作用（FCI）及前沿量子化学方法进行基准对比。

papers.title: Experimentally probing the Quantum Physics in the Inverted Harmonic Oscillator
papers.abstract: When a quantum system passes through an unstable fixed point the local dynamics reduces to the inverted harmonic oscillator (IHO). It exponentially amplifies along one quadrature while squeezing the other, producing macroscopically extended quantum states from microscopic zero-point fluctuations. We realize this dynamics with a Bose-Einstein condensate on an AtomChip. Radio-frequency dressing flips the transverse harmonic confinement into an IHO. Through phase-space tomography we follow the full Wigner function of the evolving quantum state, observe sub-vacuum squeezing of 10.6(1.3) dB, and test coherent reversibility by time-reversing the IHO evolution. Matter-wave interference between the two daughter clouds confirms quantum coherence over timescales far beyond the initial expansion. Our experiment establishes ultra-cold atoms as a clean, controlled, many-body platform for unstable quantum dynamics opening a route to force sensing with time-reversal-based coherence certification and to analog studies of the amplification of quantum fluctuations in inflationary field dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“We realize this dynamics with a Bose-Einstein condensate on an AtomChip”，并描述了具体的实验测量（如“phase-space tomography”、“observe sub-vacuum squeezing”）。；研究对象：倒置谐振子（Inverted Harmonic Oscillator, IHO）中的量子动力学，具体实现于原子芯片上的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（Bose-Einstein condensate, BEC）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验实现了倒置谐振子动力学，观测到10.6(1.3) dB的亚真空压缩，并通过时间反演验证了量子相干性，证实了量子态在远超初始膨胀时间尺度上的相干可逆性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验实现了倒置谐振子动力学，观测到10.6(1.3) dB的亚真空压缩，并通过时间反演验证了量子相干性，证实了量子态在远超初始膨胀时间尺度上的相干可逆性。；创新点：首次在超冷原子平台上以受控、清洁的多体系统实验实现并完整表征了倒置谐振子动力学，展示了亚真空压缩和长时间量子相干性，为基于时间反演的力传感和类比研究暴胀场动力学中量子涨落的放大开辟了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 利用原子芯片上的射频缀饰（radio-frequency dressing）将横向谐振束缚翻转成倒置谐振子；通过相空间层析成像（phase-space tomography）追踪演化量子态的完整Wigner函数；通过时间反演倒置谐振子演化测试相干可逆性；利用物质波干涉（matter-wave interference）验证量子相干性。

papers.title: Influence of anisotropy on the expansion performance of auxetic skin meshing geometries: a finite element study
papers.abstract: This study investigates the combined effects of anisotropy and auxetic mesh geometry on the performance of skin graft expansion. Finite element models of auxetic slit-based geometries were developed and subjected to 25 percent tensile strain. Skin was modelled using an anisotropic constitutive formulation. Langer's line orientations were varied relative to the load direction. Results showed anisotropy strongly influenced expansion behaviour. The effect was observed to be complex and highly dependent on mesh type. Anisotropy was observed to enhance or inhibit the auxetic expansion behaviour. In all mesh types studied, the expansion performance is lowest when Langer's lines align with the transverse direction. Greatest expansion was typically observed when Langer's lines were close to the loading direction. Isotropic models overpredicted stress relative to the anisotropic models. These findings support the use of auxetic structures for skin mesh expansion applications and show that anisotropy is an important factor in both deformation and stress prediction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“finite element study”（有限元研究）、“models were developed”（模型开发）。；研究对象：论文研究的具体对象是各向异性皮肤组织与拉胀（auxetic）网状几何结构（用于皮肤移植扩张）的复合系统。具体物理现象是各向异性对拉胀网状结构扩张性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 各向异性对拉胀网状结构的扩张行为有强烈且复杂的影响，其效果取决于网格类型。当Langer线（皮肤各向异性方向）与加载方向一致时，扩张性能最佳；当Langer线与横向对齐时，性能最差。各向同性模型会高估应力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：各向异性对拉胀网状结构的扩张行为有强烈且复杂的影响，其效果取决于网格类型。当Langer线（皮肤各向异性方向）与加载方向一致时，扩张性能最佳；当Langer线与横向对齐时，性能最差。各向同性模型会高估应力。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容推断，创新点在于系统研究了皮肤组织的各向异性（而非通常假设的各向同性）对拉胀网状结构在皮肤移植扩张应用中的性能影响，并揭示了其与网格类型的复杂依赖关系。
papers.method_zh: 采用有限元方法（Finite Element Method, FEM）建立基于狭缝（slit-based）的拉胀网状几何模型，并施加25%的拉伸应变。皮肤材料使用各向异性本构模型进行模拟，并改变Langer线方向与加载方向的相对角度。

papers.title: Chiral Transport in Metric-Affine Geometries
papers.abstract: Anomalous transport in equilibrium fermionic fluids chirally coupled to background Weyl-type nonmetricity is studied. A formal descent analysis is carried out in which the dependence of the anomaly polynomial on the nonmetricity tensor is encoded in a Weyl invariant four-form. The constitutive relation of the axial-vector current is evaluated from the equilibrium partition function obtained using transgression techniques, showing the existence of nonmetricity-mediated chiral separation effects driven by the fluid's vorticity and the Weyl magnetic field. A second nonminimal coupling of fermionic matter to metric-affine geometries proposed in the literature is also discussed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：formal descent analysis, equilibrium partition function, transgression techniques。；研究对象：在手性费米子流体中，与背景Weyl型非度量性（nonmetricity）耦合导致的异常输运现象。具体涉及度规-仿射几何（metric-affine geometries）中的手性分离效应（chiral separation effects）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在平衡态手性费米子流体中，非度量性张量会通过流体的涡度（vorticity）和Weyl磁场（Weyl magnetic field）介导产生手性分离效应。该效应由轴矢流（axial-vector current）的本构关系描述，并通过平衡态配分函数计算得到。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在平衡态手性费米子流体中，非度量性张量会通过流体的涡度（vorticity）和Weyl磁场（Weyl magnetic field）介导产生手性分离效应。该效应由轴矢流（axial-vector current）的本构关系描述，并通过平衡态配分函数计算得到。；创新点：首次在度规-仿射几何框架下，系统研究了由Weyl型非度量性（而非传统的曲率或挠率）所驱动的平衡态手性输运现象，并揭示了非度量性介导的手性分离效应。此外，还讨论了文献中提出的另一种费米子物质与度规-仿射几何的非最小耦合方案。
papers.method_zh: 采用形式化的降维分析（formal descent analysis），将非度量性张量对反常多项式（anomaly polynomial）的依赖编码在一个Weyl不变的4-形式中。利用上同调转移技术（transgression techniques）从平衡态配分函数推导出轴矢流的本构关系。

papers.title: Maximal Minimal Spacing for Random Points
papers.abstract: From $N+1$ random points on a line we wish to select $M+1$ points so as to maximize the minimal spacing between them. We consider an initial configuration with independent and identically distributed spacings. The problem is equivalent to optimally grouping consecutive gaps into $M$ blocks and maximizing the smallest block sum. For general gap distributions, and for all $M\leq N$, we derive exact distributional identities for the optimal spacing and obtain its asymptotic behavior. The problem admits a reformulation in terms of a threshold-resetting random walk. The walk advances by successive random increments and is reset to the origin upon exceeding a fixed threshold. The probability that the optimal spacing exceeds a given value coincides with the probability that the walk completes at least $M$ reset cycles within $N$ steps. This yields an exact representation in terms of first-passage functionals of the walk. The same mapping suggests a numerical scheme for the max-min spacing problem in the regime of large $N$ and $M$, whose accuracy is tested against the exact results obtained here.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：distributional identities、asymptotic behavior、reformulation、first-passage functionals）；研究对象：一维随机点列中最大化最小间距的优化问题，等价于将独立同分布间隔分组为M个块并最大化最小块和。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导了最优间距的精确分布恒等式及其渐近行为，并建立了与阈值重置随机游走的第一通过程泛函之间的等价关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导了最优间距的精确分布恒等式及其渐近行为，并建立了与阈值重置随机游走的第一通过程泛函之间的等价关系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 概率论与随机过程理论分析，包括分布恒等式推导、渐近分析、以及将问题映射为阈值重置随机游走模型。

papers.title: Pushing the Classical Frontier of 1D Fermi-Hubbard Quench Dynamics Beyond Current Quantum Simulations
papers.abstract: Establishing quantum advantage requires comparison against the best achievable classical simulation. The Q-CTRL team recently simulated quench dynamics of the one-dimensional Fermi-Hubbard model on an IBM processor, completing a $L=60$ evolution to time $t=6$ in under three minutes and claiming a $3000\times$ speedup over classical Time-Dependent Variational Principle (TDVP) simulation at bond dimension $χ=4096$. Their classical benchmark required over 160 hours on a CPU cluster, failed to converge in the high-entanglement regime $t\in[5.2,6]$, and left the most challenging window of the experiment unverified. Here, we push the boundaries of classical simulation by exploiting the full $\mathrm{U}(1)\times\mathrm{SU}(2)$ symmetry of the Fermi-Hubbard Hamiltonian combined with GPU-accelerated tensor contractions. Reaching bond dimensions up to $χ\approx62{,}000$ on four NVIDIA H200 GPUs -- among the largest ever achieved in TDVP simulations and fifteen times larger than Q-CTRL's classical baseline -- we achieve fully converged results across the entire simulation window, including rigorous certification of the previously unresolved high-entanglement regime $t\in[5.2,6]$. We further advance the classical frontier to $t=7$, which lies beyond the quantum hardware experiment and any previously verified classical evolution of the full wavefunction. At the bond dimension comparable to Q-CTRL's best classical run, our GPU implementation completes in $\sim\!100$ minutes, directly reducing the claimed $3000\times$ quantum advantage to $\sim\!36\times$. These results substantially narrow the quantum-classical performance gap and establish a new standard for tensor-network benchmarking of large-scale quantum simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词包括“classical simulation”、“GPU-accelerated tensor contractions”、“TDVP simulations”、“tensor-network benchmarking”。；研究对象：一维费米-哈伯德模型（1D Fermi-Hubbard model）的淬火动力学（quench dynamics）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过利用完整的U(1)×SU(2)对称性和GPU加速的张量收缩，经典模拟达到了比此前量子计算声称的基准大15倍的键维数（χ≈62,000），首次在之前无法验证的高纠缠区域（t∈[5.2,6]）实现了完全收敛的结果，并将经典模拟推进到量子硬件实验之外的t=7时刻。同时，在可比键维数下，将量子计算声称的3000倍加速比缩小至约36倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过利用完整的U(1)×SU(2)对称性和GPU加速的张量收缩，经典模拟达到了比此前量子计算声称的基准大15倍的键维数（χ≈62,000），首次在之前无法验证的高纠缠区域（t∈[5.2,6]）实现了完全收敛的结果，并将经典模拟推进到量子硬件实验之外的t=7时刻。同时，在可比键维数下，将量子计算声称的3000倍加速比缩小至约36倍。；创新点：首次在TDVP模拟中达到如此高的键维数（χ≈62,000），并成功验证了此前量子模拟中未解决的高纠缠区域（t∈[5.2,6]），同时将经典模拟推进到量子硬件实验范围之外（t=7），显著缩小了量子-经典性能差距。
papers.method_zh: 采用时间依赖变分原理（TDVP）进行经典模拟，并利用费米-哈伯德哈密顿量的完整U(1)×SU(2)对称性，结合GPU加速的张量收缩计算。模拟在四块NVIDIA H200 GPU上运行，达到键维数χ≈62,000。

papers.title: Extremely slow scaling of minimal Hamming distance in quantum sampling data
papers.abstract: Quantum data can be obtained from a diverse range of sources, including direct measurements from noisy quantum processors, cold-atom simulators, and classical approximations such as variational neural-network states. However, our ability to characterize these systems is fundamentally limited, as the available measurement data is often sparse compared to the exponentially large Hilbert space of the system. To address this, we propose using the average minimal Hamming distance calculated for a set of unique bitstrings as a robust metric revealing a universal power-law behaviour. Through various examples of real experiments and simulations, we show that the power-law parameters reliably capture the complexity of quantum states and identify quantum phase transitions from limited quantum information, without the need for accumulating extensive statistics or explicitly calculating physical observables. This enables the analysis of completely different quantum experiments within a single framework.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章（关键词：propose metric, power-law behaviour, simulations, analysis framework）；研究对象：量子采样数据（来自噪声量子处理器、冷原子模拟器、变分神经网络态等）中的量子态复杂性及量子相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出以唯一比特串集合的平均最小汉明距离作为鲁棒度量，发现其呈现普适幂律行为，且幂律参数能可靠捕捉量子态复杂性并识别量子相变，无需大量统计或显式计算物理可观测量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出以唯一比特串集合的平均最小汉明距离作为鲁棒度量，发现其呈现普适幂律行为，且幂律参数能可靠捕捉量子态复杂性并识别量子相变，无需大量统计或显式计算物理可观测量。；创新点：提出一种无需积累大量统计量或显式计算物理观测量的单一框架，可统一分析不同类型量子实验数据，并揭示量子态复杂性的普适标度行为。
papers.method_zh: 通过分析真实实验与模拟数据，计算平均最小汉明距离并拟合幂律标度，用于表征量子态信息结构。

papers.title: Minimal superfluid vortices in chiral perturbation theory
papers.abstract: We derive some properties of rotational vortices in the pion condensed phase. Employing leading order chiral perturbation theory we determine the minimal energy condition for vortex nucleation. Vortices have quantized angular momentum along the rotation axis, an hallmark of superfluidity, and self-confine pions. The critical rotation frequency for vortex nucleation is estimated.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“运用手征微扰理论”（Employing... chiral perturbation theory）进行推导和估计。；研究对象：论文研究的是在π介子凝聚相（pion condensed phase）中旋转涡旋（rotational vortices）的性质。具体物理现象是超流涡旋的成核（vortex nucleation）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文确定了π介子凝聚相中涡旋成核的最小能量条件，并估计了临界旋转频率。涡旋具有沿旋转轴量子化的角动量，这是超流性的标志，并且涡旋能够自束缚π介子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文确定了π介子凝聚相中涡旋成核的最小能量条件，并估计了临界旋转频率。涡旋具有沿旋转轴量子化的角动量，这是超流性的标志，并且涡旋能够自束缚π介子。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用了领头阶手征微扰理论（leading order chiral perturbation theory）作为理论框架，通过分析能量条件来推导涡旋性质。

papers.title: Arbitrary manipulation of nuclear spins in hexagonal boron nitride
papers.abstract: Due to its localized nature and controllability, the negatively charged boron vacancy centers (V$_\text{B}^-$) in hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) are a promising spin platform for accessing its neighboring nuclei with potential for performing quantum computational tasks. However, the methods of utilizing and manipulating the nuclear spins are still lacking. In this work, we propose a protocol for the preparation of single- and multi-qubit gates on the nuclear spins, utilizing the electron spin as an auxiliary qubit. By applying a background magnetic field and a multi-tone continuous drive, we show that the electron spin coupling to the nuclei can be efficiently engineered. This allows for suppressing the undesired electron-nuclear interactions through the Hahn echo pulse sequence. The target gates are then implemented by employing proper RF drives. Our numerical results for realistic parameters show gate fidelities as high as $99\%$ for single-qubit and $95\%$ for multi-qubit gates. With the gate execution durations being less than $300$ ns, our protocol evades electron spin decoherence effects. Therefore, our scheme sets the stage for the practical application of V$_\text{B}^-$ in hBN for quantum computation purposes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose a protocol、numerical results、scheme。；研究对象：六方氮化硼（hBN）中带负电的硼空位中心（V₋⁻）及其邻近核自旋。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种利用电子自旋作为辅助量子比特，通过背景磁场与多音连续驱动，在核自旋上实现单比特和多比特量子门的协议，数值模拟显示单比特门保真度高达99%，多比特门保真度达95%，且门操作时间小于300纳秒，可规避电子自旋退相干效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种利用电子自旋作为辅助量子比特，通过背景磁场与多音连续驱动，在核自旋上实现单比特和多比特量子门的协议，数值模拟显示单比特门保真度高达99%，多比特门保真度达95%，且门操作时间小于300纳秒，可规避电子自旋退相干效应。；创新点：针对hBN中V₋⁻核自旋操控方法缺乏的现状，首次提出了利用电子自旋作为辅助实现核自旋任意操控的完整协议，并展示了高保真度与快速门操作。
papers.method_zh: 理论方案设计：利用电子自旋与核自旋的耦合，通过施加背景磁场和多音连续驱动来工程化电子-核相互作用，并采用Hahn回波脉冲序列抑制非期望的电子-核相互作用，最后通过适当的射频驱动实现目标量子门。数值模拟基于实际参数计算门保真度。

papers.title: Discrete signaling mediates chaotic regularization in recurrent neural networks
papers.abstract: Cortical circuits operate in a regime of intrinsic chaos, where even tiny changes in input can lead to divergent neural responses. Yet, remarkably, population codes in the brain vary smoothly with sensory stimuli, forming coherent representational manifolds. How can chaotic networks sustain such stable coding? Here, we develop a theoretical framework that links the microscopic chaos of recurrent networks to the macroscopic geometry of neural representations. Combining kernel methods with dynamical mean-field theory, we show that chaotic dynamics induce local roughness (introducing sharp distortions at small scales) while preserving global smoothness across larger stimulus variations. This structural property acts as an intrinsic regularizer, enhancing generalization while maintaining expressivity. Moreover, we show how chaotic networks naturally produce power-law spectral signatures, closely matching experimental observations in cortical recordings. These results explain how chaotic spiking networks can sustain smooth, differentiable population codes and establish a theoretical framework linking network dynamics, computational structure, and recorded neural activity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：theoretical framework、kernel methods、dynamical mean-field theory）；研究对象：混沌递归神经网络中的神经表征几何结构，以及其与皮层回路中混沌动力学的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 混沌动力学在递归神经网络中引入局部粗糙性（小尺度上的尖锐扭曲），同时保持全局平滑性，从而作为内在正则化器增强泛化能力，并自然产生与皮层记录实验匹配的幂律谱特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：混沌动力学在递归神经网络中引入局部粗糙性（小尺度上的尖锐扭曲），同时保持全局平滑性，从而作为内在正则化器增强泛化能力，并自然产生与皮层记录实验匹配的幂律谱特征。；创新点：建立了从微观混沌动力学到宏观神经表征几何的理论桥梁，揭示了混沌如何作为内在正则化机制维持平滑、可微分的群体编码，并解释了混沌网络产生幂律谱特征的机制。
papers.method_zh: 结合核方法与动力学平均场理论（dynamical mean-field theory）进行理论分析。

papers.title: Shortcomings and capacities of real-constrained neural networks in complex spaces
papers.abstract: We find the asymptotic ratio between the storage capacities when enforcing real pre-activations in a complex hypothesis class as opposed to complex ones in the same class. Our methods depend on Gardner volume comparisons at critical capacity. Our proof relies on an application of the Harish-Chandra-Itzykson-Zuber (HCIZ) formula, nonstandard in literature. With the HCIZ formula, we may obtain a more robust approximation for the final asymptotic ratio. This strategy is applicable to our work specifically since we integrate over the unitary and orthogonal compact manifolds, facilitated via the Weyl integration formula and the Haar measure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：asymptotic ratio、Gardner volume comparisons、HCIZ formula、Weyl integration formula、Haar measure。；研究对象：实约束神经网络在复空间中的存储容量问题，具体研究在复假设类中强制使用实预激活（real pre-activations）与使用复预激活时的存储容量渐近比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文找到了在复假设类中强制实预激活与使用复预激活时，存储容量之间的渐近比值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文找到了在复假设类中强制实预激活与使用复预激活时，存储容量之间的渐近比值。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用Gardner容量比较方法，在临界容量处进行体积比较；应用Harish-Chandra-Itzykson-Zuber（HCIZ）公式（该公式在文献中不常见）获得更稳健的渐近比近似；通过Weyl积分公式和Haar测度在酉群和正交群紧流形上进行积分。

papers.title: Coarse graining from within: Wilson-Fisher universality on $S^3$
papers.abstract: Wilsonian renormalization is usually formulated in momentum space, but on curved backgrounds momentum shells have no invariant meaning. We replace them by an intrinsic spectral cutoff, ordering modes by the covariant Laplacian and setting the cutoff resolution by the system size in renormalization group (RG) units. For a scalar field on $S^3$, this yields a covariant, momentum-free RG flow whose trace is an exact sum over spherical harmonics. The standard flat-space flow is recovered when the sphere is large compared with the coarse-graining scale. As a nontrivial test, the compact spectral flow realizes Wilson-Fisher universality without momentum shells: the interacting fixed point survives at finite resolution, has one relevant direction, and approaches its flat-space counterpart smoothly, with critical exponents only weakly affected by the compact spectrum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Wilsonian renormalization、covariant spectral cutoff、RG flow、fixed point。；研究对象：在三维球面 \( S^3 \) 上的标量场理论，具体研究其重整化群流与 Wilson-Fisher 普适类。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 \( S^3 \) 上使用协变谱截断（而非动量壳）的重整化群流，能够实现 Wilson-Fisher 普适类：相互作用不动点存在、只有一个相关方向，且临界指数受紧致谱影响很小，在球半径远大于粗粒化尺度时平滑过渡到平空间结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 \( S^3 \) 上使用协变谱截断（而非动量壳）的重整化群流，能够实现 Wilson-Fisher 普适类：相互作用不动点存在、只有一个相关方向，且临界指数受紧致谱影响很小，在球半径远大于粗粒化尺度时平滑过渡到平空间结果。；创新点：首次在弯曲背景（\( S^3 \)）上，通过纯谱截断（而非动量壳）实现 Wilson-Fisher 普适类，证明了重整化群流可以不依赖动量空间而仅依赖协变谱结构。
papers.method_zh: 采用内禀谱截断替代动量壳，按协变拉普拉斯算子的本征模式（球谐函数）排序，并以重整化群单位下的系统尺寸设定截断分辨率，从而在 \( S^3 \) 上构建无动量概念的重整化群流。

papers.title: Quantum error correction with the toric code
papers.abstract: Quantum computing platforms based on arrays of tweezer-confined neutral atoms have recently emerged as a competitive modality thanks to a direct path toward high qubit count, rapidly advancing operation fidelities, and their ability to execute circuits with arbitrary qubit connectivity. These features will enable the use of efficient error correction schemes with high encoding-rates, time-efficient decoding, and resource-efficient architectures based on transversal gates. With these goals in mind, recent state of the art neutral atom demonstrations focus on the transition from the use of physical qubits to error-corrected logical qubits, but to date there has been no demonstration of repeated error correction scalable to arbitrary depth. Here, we demonstrate many cycles of syndrome extraction in a toric quantum error correcting code, using mid-circuit measurement and replacement of lost qubits, including reloading of a qubit reservoir for indefinite coherent operation. We characterize the logical error rate after up to 90 cycles, showing that logical information can be preserved through multiple rounds of qubit reloading. Comparing two distances of the code up to 8 rounds of syndrome extraction shows a lower absolute logical error rate for the larger distance code.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“demonstrate”、“characterize”等实验性动词，并描述了具体实验操作（如mid-circuit measurement、replacement of lost qubits、reloading of a qubit reservoir）。；研究对象：基于中性原子阵列的量子计算平台，具体研究toric量子纠错码（toric code）中的重复纠错过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在toric量子纠错码中成功实现了多达90个周期的综合征提取，并通过多次量子比特重装操作保持了逻辑信息的完整性；更大距离的码在8个综合征提取周期内表现出更低的绝对逻辑错误率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在toric量子纠错码中成功实现了多达90个周期的综合征提取，并通过多次量子比特重装操作保持了逻辑信息的完整性；更大距离的码在8个综合征提取周期内表现出更低的绝对逻辑错误率。；创新点：首次展示了可扩展至任意深度的重复纠错（而非单次或有限次纠错），并实现了通过量子比特储备库重装来维持无限相干操作的能力。
papers.method_zh: 使用光镊束缚的中性原子阵列作为量子比特平台，通过电路中间测量（mid-circuit measurement）和丢失量子比特替换（包括从量子比特储备库重新加载）实现toric码的重复纠错循环。

papers.title: Ulam Approximation for Nonautonomous Systems: Equivariant Measures and Linear Response
papers.abstract: Despite the prevalence of nonautonomous systems in applications, their statistical properties are much less understood than in the autonomous setting. Building on recent results on response theory for nonautonomous systems, we study the approximation of equivariant families and of their linear response by Ulam-type finite-dimensional reductions. First, we show that coarse-graining procedures associated with the classical Ulam method, and more generally with suitable finite-element projections, provide rigorous approximation of equivariant families for sequential systems with memory loss. Second, for systems whose transfer operators are regularizing, we prove that the linear response of the reduced finite-state Markov model converges to the projected linear response of the original system. To the best of our knowledge, a general approximation result of this type has not previously been established in this form, even in the autonomous case. We complement the analysis with numerical experiments on simple but representative time-dependent diffusive models. These results provide a rigorous foundation for the use of Markov approximations in the study of statistical properties of nonautonomous complex systems which almost invariably relies on finite-scale and finite-precision descriptions of their states and dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：approximation, linear response, Ulam-type finite-dimensional reductions, numerical experiments）；研究对象：非自治动力系统的统计性质，特别是其等变测度族与线性响应的近似问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了经典Ulam方法（及更一般的有限元投影）可以严格近似具有记忆丧失的序列系统的等变测度族；对于传递算子具有正则化性质的系统，证明了约化后的有限状态马尔可夫模型的线性响应收敛于原系统的投影线性响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了经典Ulam方法（及更一般的有限元投影）可以严格近似具有记忆丧失的序列系统的等变测度族；对于传递算子具有正则化性质的系统，证明了约化后的有限状态马尔可夫模型的线性响应收敛于原系统的投影线性响应。；创新点：首次以一般形式建立了非自治系统（甚至自治系统）的等变测度族与线性响应的Ulam近似收敛性结果。摘要未突出说明与已有自治系统结果的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于Ulam型有限维约化（粗粒化过程）与有限元投影的理论框架，结合数值实验（简单但具代表性的含时扩散模型）。

papers.title: Spontaneous irreversibility and objective thermalization in stochastic modifications of quantum theory
papers.abstract: The deterministic and time-reversal symmetric dynamics of isolated quantum systems is at odds with irreversible equilibration observed in generic thermodynamic systems. Standard approaches at a reconciliation employ subjective restrictions on the space of observables or states and do not explain how a single macroscopic quantum system achieves equilibrium dynamically. We instead argue that quantum theory is an effective theory and requires corrections to accurately describe systems approaching the thermodynamic limit. We construct a stochastic extension of quantum theory which is practically identical to quantum mechanics for microscopic systems, yet allows individual macroscopic and isolated systems to objectively thermalize, generically. A fluctuation-dissipation relation guarantees physical consistency including norm preservation, energy conservation, no superluminal signalling and the emergence of microcanonical equilibrium. We further discuss the inclusion of objective collapse, thereby realizing a falsifiable theory of spontaneous universal irreversibility which describes the quantum-to-classical crossover dynamics of macroscopic quantum systems. The dynamics of the model describe spontaneous symmetry breaking, quantum state reduction and objective quantum thermalization for individual systems, while realizing emergent hybrid statistics for ensembles that integrate Born's rule and microcanonical equilibrium.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：stochastic extension of quantum theory（随机扩展）、theoretical framework（理论框架）、falsifiable theory（可证伪理论）。；研究对象：孤立量子系统在热力学极限下的自发不可逆性与客观热化现象，以及量子到经典过渡的动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过构建量子理论的随机扩展，使孤立宏观量子系统能够自发、客观地热化，并满足规范守恒、能量守恒、无超光速信号等物理一致性条件，同时实现自发对称性破缺、量子态约化与客观量子热化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过构建量子理论的随机扩展，使孤立宏观量子系统能够自发、客观地热化，并满足规范守恒、能量守恒、无超光速信号等物理一致性条件，同时实现自发对称性破缺、量子态约化与客观量子热化。；创新点：提出量子理论作为有效理论需要修正才能准确描述接近热力学极限的系统，并构建了与微观量子力学几乎一致、但允许宏观孤立系统客观热化的随机扩展模型，同时整合了玻恩规则与微正则系综的混合统计。
papers.method_zh: 采用随机扩展量子理论的方法，引入涨落-耗散关系（fluctuation-dissipation relation）保证物理一致性，并进一步纳入客观坍缩机制（objective collapse），构建可证伪的自发普遍不可逆性理论。

papers.title: Bipolar-doped superconducting infinite-layer cuprates
papers.abstract: Distilling the intrinsic physics of the superconducting CuO2 plane from the complexities of charge-reservoir layers is a defining challenge in high-temperature superconductivity. While superconducting electron-doped infinite-layer cuprates have been synthesized, controllable and uniform hole doping has long remained elusive despite exploratory attempts, limiting spectroscopic insights. Here, we realize bipolar doping across infinite-layer (Sr,Eu)CuO2 and (Ca,Li)CuO2+δ single-crystalline thin films, mapping the electronic phase diagram. Both electron- and hole-doped films show pronounced electrical resistance anisotropy, indicating the quasi-two-dimensional nature of the CuO2 planes. Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy across electron- and hole-doped regimes reveals persistent antiferromagnetic band folding coexisting with superconductivity. Remarkably, at a hole doping ~0.07 determined by Luttinger volume, the antiferromagnetic folding emerges from Fermi arcs within the film's single Fermi surface, with the onset superconducting transition temperature exceeding 60 K. These findings redefine the interplay between magnetic order and superconductivity and establish a definitive platform to investigate the intrinsic mechanism of high-temperature superconducting cuprates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：synthesized、thin films、electrical resistance anisotropy、Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES)。；研究对象：无限层铜氧化物超导体，具体为(Sr,Eu)CuO₂和(Ca,Li)CuO₂+δ单晶薄膜，以及其CuO₂面的电子相图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实现了无限层铜氧化物中可控且均匀的双极性（电子和空穴）掺杂，并在空穴掺杂约0.07时观察到反铁磁能带折叠与超导电性共存，超导转变温度超过60 K。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实现了无限层铜氧化物中可控且均匀的双极性（电子和空穴）掺杂，并在空穴掺杂约0.07时观察到反铁磁能带折叠与超导电性共存，超导转变温度超过60 K。；创新点：首次在无限层铜氧化物中实现了可控且均匀的空穴掺杂，从而完整绘制了电子相图，并利用ARPES直接观测到空穴掺杂区反铁磁折叠与超导的共存，为研究高温超导机理提供了明确的平台。
papers.method_zh: 薄膜生长（单晶薄膜合成）、电输运测量（电阻各向异性）、角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）。

papers.title: Topological Weyl Phase of an Ideal Spin-Gapless Semiconductor KCrSe
papers.abstract: The coexistence of topological and spin-polarized electronic states within a single material platform provides an attractive route toward emergent quantum phenomena and spintronic functionalities. However, materials simultaneously exhibiting spin-gapless semiconducting (SGS) behavior and Weyl semimetallicity remain exceedingly rare. Here, using first-principles calculations, we identify the half-Heusler compound KCrSe as an ideal spin-gapless Weyl semimetal. Transport calculations reveal a weak temperature dependence of the longitudinal conductivity and relatively small Seebeck coefficients, providing further evidence of its SGS nature. KCrSe hosts a single pair of Weyl nodes-the minimum number permitted in a Weyl semimetal-located in close proximity to the Fermi level (E$_\text{F}$), resulting in exceptionally clean bulk and surface electronic spectra. The nontrivial Berry curvature associated with these Weyl nodes gives rise to sizable anomalous transport responses, including an anomalous Hall conductivity of $σ_{xy}^{A}\sim 90.76~\mathrm{S\,cm^{-1}}$ and an anomalous Nernst conductivity of $α_{xy}^{A}\sim 0.15~\mathrm{A\,m^{-1}K^{-1}}$ at E$_\text{F}$, with substantially enhanced values at lower energies. The combination of an ideal Weyl topology, fully spin-polarized low-energy states, and finite anomalous transport establishes KCrSe as a promising platform for designing high-efficiency topological spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）、“transport calculations”（输运计算）。；研究对象：半赫斯勒化合物KCrSe，具体研究其作为理想自旋无带隙半导体（SGS）与Weyl半金属的共存态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: KCrSe是一种理想的自旋无带隙Weyl半金属，拥有最小数量（一对）且靠近费米能级的Weyl节点，并表现出显著的反常输运响应（反常霍尔电导率约90.76 S/cm，反常能斯特电导率约0.15 A/m·K）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：KCrSe是一种理想的自旋无带隙Weyl半金属，拥有最小数量（一对）且靠近费米能级的Weyl节点，并表现出显著的反常输运响应（反常霍尔电导率约90.76 S/cm，反常能斯特电导率约0.15 A/m·K）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）以及输运计算（transport calculations）。

papers.title: Emergent cohesion via self-caging in maximally entangled rod packings
papers.abstract: Random packings of disordered rigid rods exhibit emergent cohesion, as exemplified in a nest of twigs that is self-equilibrated, free-standing structures. We analyze the geometric motif underlying this cohesion using a rod packing that maximizes the average crossing number subject to non-penetration constraints. We show that this protocol leads to self-caging: collective geometric constraints that prevent rod escape even in finite systems with free boundaries, leading to packings that remain mechanically cohesive due to a combination of purely repulsive and frictional interactions. We show that self-caging is controlled by the available free-volume in translational and rotational configuration spaces, which is minimal when $N/(Zα)=1/3$ where $N$ is the number of rods, $α$ is the aspect ratio, and $Z$ is the average coordination number. Our results establish a minimal geometric motif for entanglement-induced cohesion in athermal rod packings, with implications for cohesive granular matter without attractive forces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：maximizes the average crossing number、geometric motif、free-volume analysis。；研究对象：无规刚性棒状颗粒的随机堆积体系，具体研究其中因纠缠而产生的内聚（emergent cohesion）现象，如树枝堆中自平衡、自支撑的结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过最大化平均交叉数的堆积协议，实现了“自囚禁”（self-caging）：即使系统有限且边界自由，集体几何约束也能阻止棒状颗粒逃逸，使堆积体仅靠纯排斥和摩擦作用保持力学内聚。自囚禁由平动和转动构型空间中的可用自由体积控制，当 N/(Zα)=1/3 时自由体积最小（N为棒数，α为长径比，Z为平均配位数）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过最大化平均交叉数的堆积协议，实现了“自囚禁”（self-caging）：即使系统有限且边界自由，集体几何约束也能阻止棒状颗粒逃逸，使堆积体仅靠纯排斥和摩擦作用保持力学内聚。自囚禁由平动和转动构型空间中的可用自由体积控制，当 N/(Zα)=1/3 时自由体积最小（N为棒数，α为长径比，Z为平均配位数）。；创新点：建立了无热棒状颗粒堆积中纠缠诱导内聚的最小几何基序（minimal geometric motif），揭示了无需吸引力即可实现内聚颗粒物质的机制。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用几何优化协议，在非穿透约束下最大化棒状颗粒堆积的平均交叉数；通过分析平动和转动自由体积来量化自囚禁条件。

papers.title: Emergent Hall viscosity in the integer quantum Hall phases of graphene-like systems
papers.abstract: We explicitly distinguish Hall viscosity as defined relative to the strain field vs. relative to an emergent vielbein or metric field and discuss it for graphene-like systems. Aside from the gravitational or vielbein/metric related ``geometric'' Hall viscosity prevailing throughout the literature, a contribution proportional to the Hall conductivity, the ``electronic'' Hall viscosity, due to the emergent strain induced gauge field exists. We unify both contributions within the ``emergent'' Hall viscosity, determine it explicitly for graphene in the semimetal and Semenoff semiconducting phases for integer quantum Hall states and in the latter case compare it to its non-relativistic limit. Under these circumstances two topological invariants enter the emergent Hall viscosity in the presence of translational and rotational symmetry which we derive in the Green function representation of Wigner-Weyl calculus. We discuss experimental perspectives for extracting the emergent Hall viscosity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“distinguish”“discuss”“unify”“determine”“derive”等理论分析词汇，未提及实验或计算模拟手段。；研究对象：石墨烯类体系（graphene-like systems）在整数量子霍尔相中的涌现霍尔粘度（emergent Hall viscosity），具体包括石墨烯的半金属相和Semenoff半导体相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在石墨烯类体系的整数量子霍尔相中，霍尔粘度包含两种贡献：一种是与引力/标架场相关的“几何”霍尔粘度，另一种是由应变诱导的规范场产生的、与霍尔电导成正比的“电子”霍尔粘度。作者将两者统一为“涌现霍尔粘度”，并发现平移和旋转对称性下有两个拓扑不变量进入该粘度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在石墨烯类体系的整数量子霍尔相中，霍尔粘度包含两种贡献：一种是与引力/标架场相关的“几何”霍尔粘度，另一种是由应变诱导的规范场产生的、与霍尔电导成正比的“电子”霍尔粘度。作者将两者统一为“涌现霍尔粘度”，并发现平移和旋转对称性下有两个拓扑不变量进入该粘度。；创新点：明确区分了相对于应变场和相对于涌现标架/度规场定义的霍尔粘度，并首次将“几何”与“电子”两种贡献统一为涌现霍尔粘度，同时给出了其在平移和旋转对称性下的拓扑不变量形式。摘要未突出说明与实验的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用Wigner-Weyl微积分中的格林函数表示（Green function representation of Wigner-Weyl calculus）进行理论推导，并对比了非相对论极限。

papers.title: Spin-chiral electron-phonon coupling in metallic strontium titanate
papers.abstract: Electron-phonon coupling (EPC) - the interaction between conduction electrons and quantized atomic vibrations - plays a central role in condensed matter physics and determines some of the most important properties of materials, such as electrical resistivity and superconductivity. Conventionally, EPC is assumed to be induced by the ionic electrostatic background, and electronic spin plays no role in the process. In stark contrast with this view, here we uncover a direct spin-mediated coupling mechanism between electrons and transverse polar phonons in a metal. Using far-infrared light absorption measurements of the model system SrTiO$_3$ in a magnetic field, we observe a strong spin-mediated EPC that is quantitatively consistent with recent theoretical predictions, and that generates chiral phonon modes with large effective magnetic moments. The extracted coupling strength is in good agreement with ab initio estimates and sufficiently high to explain superconductivity in SrTiO$_3$, thereby resolving a long-standing conundrum. Spin-chiral EPC should generically appear in all metals with polar phonons, and the present work could be of relevance to spintronics applications and to uncovering the origins of superconductivity in layered materials, metals with Dirac points in their electronic dispersions, and nearly ferroelectric superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：far-infrared light absorption measurements, magnetic field）；研究对象：金属态钛酸锶（SrTiO₃）中的电子-声子耦合，特别是电子自旋与横向极性声子之间的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在金属态SrTiO₃中，发现了一种由电子自旋直接介导的、与横向极性声子耦合的新机制（自旋手性电子-声子耦合），该耦合强度足以解释SrTiO₃的超导电性，并产生了具有大有效磁矩的手性声子模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在金属态SrTiO₃中，发现了一种由电子自旋直接介导的、与横向极性声子耦合的新机制（自旋手性电子-声子耦合），该耦合强度足以解释SrTiO₃的超导电性，并产生了具有大有效磁矩的手性声子模式。；创新点：颠覆了传统认为电子-声子耦合仅由离子静电背景诱导、电子自旋不起作用的观点，首次在实验上揭示并定量验证了自旋直接介导的电子-声子耦合机制。
papers.method_zh: 在磁场下对SrTiO₃进行远红外光吸收测量，并结合第一性原理（ab initio）计算进行定量比较。

papers.title: Bernoulli principle in ferroelectrics
papers.abstract: Ferroelectric materials, characterized by spontaneous electric polarization, exhibit remarkable parallels with fluid dynamics, where polarization flux behaves similarly to fluid flow. Understanding polarization distribution in confined geometries at the nanoscale is crucial for both fundamental physics and technological applications. Here, we show that the classical Bernoulli principle, which describes the conservation of the energy flux along velocity streamlines in a moving fluid, can be extended to the conservation of polarization flux in ferroelectric nanorods with varying cross-sectional areas. Geometric constrictions lead to an increase in polarization, resembling fluid acceleration in a narrowing pipe, while expansions cause a decrease. Beyond a critical expansion, phase separation occurs, giving rise to topological polarization structures such as polarization bubbles, curls and Hopfions. This effect extends to soft ferroelectrics, including ferroelectric nematic liquid crystals, where polarization flux conservation governs the formation of complex mesoscale states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“show that”“can be extended”等理论推导性表述，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：铁电材料中的极化分布，特别是变截面纳米棒中的极化通量行为，以及软铁电体（如铁电向列液晶）中的拓扑极化结构（极化气泡、卷曲、Hopfion）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 经典流体力学中的伯努利原理可推广至铁电体：在变截面铁电纳米棒中，极化通量守恒导致几何收缩处极化增强、扩张处极化减弱；超过临界扩张时发生相分离，形成极化气泡、卷曲和Hopfion等拓扑结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：经典流体力学中的伯努利原理可推广至铁电体：在变截面铁电纳米棒中，极化通量守恒导致几何收缩处极化增强、扩张处极化减弱；超过临界扩张时发生相分离，形成极化气泡、卷曲和Hopfion等拓扑结构。；创新点：首次将伯努利原理从流体动力学推广至铁电体系，揭示了几何约束对极化分布和拓扑结构形成的调控机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于极化通量守恒与流体动力学类比，未使用具体数值计算或实验手段（摘要未明确说明具体理论框架）。

papers.title: Axial dispersion in dilute solutions of linear and branched polymers in parallel-plate and expansion-contraction microchannels
papers.abstract: The axial dispersion of polymers in microchannels depends on an interplay between microchannel geometry, polymer architecture, and hydrodynamics. Here, we investigate the axial dispersion of linear, comb, and star polymers in parallel-plate and sinusoidal expansion-contraction microchannels at dilute concentrations using multiparticle collision dynamics simulations. The polymers all contain the same number of monomers but differ in their architecture, and their concentration is fixed at either one value that is dilute for all polymers or the same value relative to the overlap concentration for each polymer. The dispersion coefficients measured at a nominal solvent volumetric flow rate are found to depend on both architecture and concentration. We show that the dispersion coefficients collapse as a function of the Péclet number after accounting for confinement effects on the polymer diffusion coefficient and polymer contributions to the flow field, and the dispersion coefficients in the parallel-plate microchannel can be reasonably predicted using a theory that accounts for inhomogeneous distribution of the polymers in the microchannel.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用“multiparticle collision dynamics simulations”（多粒子碰撞动力学模拟）作为研究方法。；研究对象：线性、梳形和星形聚合物在平行板微通道和正弦膨胀-收缩微通道中的轴向分散行为，重点关注稀溶液条件下聚合物构型与流体动力学对分散的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 聚合物的轴向分散系数依赖于其构型和浓度，在考虑聚合物扩散系数的受限效应及聚合物对流场的贡献后，分散系数可随Péclet数归一化；平行板微通道中的分散系数可通过考虑聚合物在通道内非均匀分布的理论进行合理预测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：聚合物的轴向分散系数依赖于其构型和浓度，在考虑聚合物扩散系数的受限效应及聚合物对流场的贡献后，分散系数可随Péclet数归一化；平行板微通道中的分散系数可通过考虑聚合物在通道内非均匀分布的理论进行合理预测。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 多粒子碰撞动力学（MPC）模拟。

papers.title: Data-driven mapping of borophene growth pathways
papers.abstract: Deterministic synthesis of borophene remains challenging because many polymorphs compete during nucleation and growth. Here we combine a reactive machine-learned interatomic potential with grand-canonical Monte Carlo simulations and data-driven structural classification to track borophene formation from early nuclei to extended layers on Ag(111) and Ag(100). We build temperature-pressure substrate growth maps and resolve how vacancy motifs, phase intermixing and seed structure govern polymorph selection. The simulations reproduce key experimental trends, including the prevalence of $β_{12}$/$χ_3$ phases and their temperature-dependent competition, while revealing kinetic pathways that connect metastable nuclei to long-range order. We identify conditions that suppress competing motifs and promote targeted phases, providing actionable synthesis windows. These results establish a predictive framework for directing borophene growth and, more broadly, for controlling polymorphism in low-dimensional materials by coupling atomistic simulation with machine-learning-enabled phase recognition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：machine-learned interatomic potential、grand-canonical Monte Carlo simulations、data-driven structural classification）；研究对象：硼烯（borophene）在Ag(111)和Ag(100)衬底上的生长路径与多晶型竞争机制
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过构建温度-压力-衬底生长图谱，揭示了空位构型、相混合及种子结构如何决定硼烯多晶型的选择，并识别出抑制竞争相、促进目标相的可操作合成窗口。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过构建温度-压力-衬底生长图谱，揭示了空位构型、相混合及种子结构如何决定硼烯多晶型的选择，并识别出抑制竞争相、促进目标相的可操作合成窗口。；创新点：建立了将原子尺度模拟与机器学习辅助相识别相结合的预测框架，用于定向控制硼烯生长及低维材料中的多晶型现象。
papers.method_zh: 结合反应性机器学习原子间势（reactive machine-learned interatomic potential）、巨正则蒙特卡洛模拟（grand-canonical Monte Carlo simulations）以及数据驱动的结构分类方法，追踪从早期核到扩展层的形成过程。

papers.title: 20 Second Parity Lifetime in an InAs--Pb Tetron Device
papers.abstract: A central promise of topological quantum computing is that increasing the excitation gap improves device performance significantly. Here, we experimentally validate this principle in an InAs--Pb tetron device via interferometric single-shot parity measurements. By replacing aluminum with the higher-gap superconductor lead in our superconductor-semiconductor hybrid devices, we have improved the robustness of our topological phase. In addition, to enable fast and precise bring-up at scale, we have developed an rf measurement technique that resolves low-energy wire-end states and directly measures their energy splitting with $μ\text{eV}$ precision. We employ this technique to bring up a device in a multi-tetron array and perform parity measurements of one of the tetron's hybrid nanowires (NWs). By controllably switching the wire parity, we observe $h/2e$-periodic bimodal shifts in the quantum capacitance of a quantum dot coupled to the hybrid nanowire in an interference loop. Further time-resolved measurements reveal a characteristic parity switching time of $\sim 20$ s with some instances reaching minute-scale. Such extremely long parity lifetimes are orders of magnitude longer than typical qubit operation times, which are on the order of $μ\text{s}$. Finally, we discuss potential implications for the fidelity of Pauli measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“experimentally validate”、“single-shot parity measurements”、“rf measurement technique”等关键词，描述了具体的实验操作和测量。；研究对象：InAs-Pb tetron器件。具体而言，研究对象是基于InAs半导体纳米线和Pb超导体构成的混合超导-半导体四端结（tetron）器件，以及其中拓扑相的鲁棒性和马约拉纳零模的宇称特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将传统超导体铝替换为更高能隙的铅，显著提升了拓扑相的鲁棒性，并在InAs-Pb tetron器件中实现了长达约20秒（部分可达分钟量级）的宇称寿命，比典型量子比特操作时间（微秒量级）长数个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将传统超导体铝替换为更高能隙的铅，显著提升了拓扑相的鲁棒性，并在InAs-Pb tetron器件中实现了长达约20秒（部分可达分钟量级）的宇称寿命，比典型量子比特操作时间（微秒量级）长数个数量级。；创新点：1. 在超导-半导体混合器件中，用高能隙超导体铅替代传统的铝，实验验证了增大激发能隙可显著提升拓扑相性能这一核心原理。2. 开发了一种高精度射频测量技术，用于快速、精确地调谐多tetron阵列中的器件。3. 在tetron器件中观测到极长的宇称寿命（~20秒），远超典型量子比特操作时间，为高保真度泡利测量提供了可能。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用了干涉式单发宇称测量（interferometric single-shot parity measurements）和射频测量技术（rf measurement technique）。该射频技术能够以微电子伏特（μeV）精度分辨低能线端态并直接测量其能量劈裂。具体测量了与混合纳米线耦合的量子点的量子电容，通过观察h/2e周期的双峰位移来探测纳米线的宇称。

papers.title: Modification of Charge and Spin Textures by Light Chemical Substitution in Eu(Al$_{1-x}$Ga$_{x}$)$_4$ ($x=0.1$)
papers.abstract: We present the results of a resonant X-ray diffraction experiment, resolving both charge and spin textures in the intermetallic topological magnet Eu(Al$_{1-x}$Ga$_{x}$)$_4$, $x$ = 0.1. Below $\approx$ 75 K the system develops a charge density wave (CDW) with propagation vector kCDW ~ (0, 0, 0.18). The CDW order parameter grows monotonically on cooling until ~ 15 K, when a sudden decrease in the CDW amplitude occurs. Pairs of magnetic satellites of the (0, 0, 8) Bragg reflection corresponding to two distinct domains, k = ($\pm δ_\text{m}$, 0, 0), k2 = (0, $\pmδ_\text{m}$, 0), $δ_\text{m} = 0.2002(4)$ were studied at the Eu L3 edge, appearing below TN = 14.8 K. Our measurement of TN is exactly coincident with the sudden drop in the CDW amplitude, which suggests strong coupling between the charge and spin orders, as observed in other compounds of the Eu(Al$_{1-x}$Ga$_{x}$)$_4$ series. Azimuthal measurements revealed a single helical spin arrangement with an elliptical envelope of $μ_\text{Y}/μ_\text{Z}$ = 1.19(6) for the k2 domain, and a tilted helical (helicoidal) spin arrangement for the k1 domain, with $μ_\text{Y}/μ_\text{Z}$ = 1.14(4) and $μ_\text{X}/μ_\text{Z}$ = 0.20(2) that may be hidden for the k2 domain due to multiple subdomains. Temperature evolution of the magnetic satellite intensities in linear and circularly polarised light found the respective ratio to be invariant with temperature, suggesting a single magnetic phase below TN. This behaviour is unlike the x = 0 material, in which a spin density wave forms first, transitioning to a helical ground state on cooling through intermediate phases. Future theoretical work on the Eu electronic ground state, supported by related experiments, will help understand the effects of Ga substitution on the evolution of the magnetic structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“resonant X-ray diffraction experiment”（共振X射线衍射实验）。；研究对象：拓扑磁体Eu(Al₁₋ₓGaₓ)₄（x=0.1）中的电荷密度波（CDW）与自旋织构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Eu(Al₀.₉Ga₀.₁)₄中，电荷密度波（CDW）在约15 K时振幅突然下降，与磁有序温度（TN=14.8 K）精确重合，表明电荷与自旋序之间存在强耦合；磁结构为单一螺旋相，且与x=0母体材料中先形成自旋密度波再过渡到螺旋基态的行为不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Eu(Al₀.₉Ga₀.₁)₄中，电荷密度波（CDW）在约15 K时振幅突然下降，与磁有序温度（TN=14.8 K）精确重合，表明电荷与自旋序之间存在强耦合；磁结构为单一螺旋相，且与x=0母体材料中先形成自旋密度波再过渡到螺旋基态的行为不同。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 共振X射线衍射实验，在Eu L₃边测量了(0,0,8)布拉格反射的磁卫星峰，并进行了方位角测量以及线偏振和圆偏振光下的温度演化测量。

papers.title: Predicting core-level X-ray photoemission spectra of oxide surfaces from first principles -- a case study for SnO$_2$
papers.abstract: X-ray photoemission spectroscopy (XPS) is a powerful technique to gain insight into the chemical properties of oxide surfaces. However, the interpretation of XPS spectra is notoriously difficult as realistic surfaces contain different terminations, reconstructions, adsorbates and defects all of which leave (potentially overlapping) spectroscopic fingerprints. To address this challenge, we present a first-principles approach based on the Z+1 method that allows us to predict XPS spectra of oxide surfaces which can directly be compared to experimental measurements. We present results for different SnO$_2$ (110) surfaces: the stoichiometric surface, surfaces with different types of vacancies (one of which is the fully reduced surface) and also the fully reduced surface with adsorbed OH and O$_2$ molecules. For these systems, we calculate the O 1s core-electron binding energies of all oxygen atoms and then use this to predict the XPS spectrum. We find that the fully reduced surface gives rise to a highly symmetric peak shape in agreement with recent XPS measurements. In contrast, the spectrum of the stoichiometric surface exhibits an additional feature at low binding energies caused by the bridging oxygen atoms at the surface. For the reduced surface with OH and O$_2$ adsorbates, the spectrum exhibits additional features at higher binding energies. The predicted spectra are in good agreement with experimental results obtained for reduced surfaces that have been exposed to oxygen gas. The presented method is general and can be straightforwardly applied to other surfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles approach”、“Z+1 method”、“calculate”、“predict”。；研究对象：SnO₂ (110) 表面的X射线光电子能谱（XPS），具体包括化学计量比表面、含不同氧空位的表面（包括完全还原表面），以及吸附OH和O₂分子的完全还原表面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 完全还原的SnO₂(110)表面产生高度对称的O 1s XPS峰形，与近期实验一致；而化学计量比表面在低结合能处出现由桥接氧原子引起的额外特征；吸附OH和O₂后，谱图在高结合能处出现额外特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：完全还原的SnO₂(110)表面产生高度对称的O 1s XPS峰形，与近期实验一致；而化学计量比表面在低结合能处出现由桥接氧原子引起的额外特征；吸附OH和O₂后，谱图在高结合能处出现额外特征。；创新点：提出了一种通用的第一性原理方法（基于Z+1方法），能够直接预测氧化物表面的XPS谱图并与实验测量进行对比，解决了真实表面因不同终止、重构、吸附物和缺陷导致谱图难以解释的问题。
papers.method_zh: 基于Z+1方法的第一性原理计算，用于预测氧化物表面的XPS谱图。具体计算了所有氧原子的O 1s芯电子结合能，并据此预测XPS谱线。

papers.title: Quantitative Detection of Molecular Oxygen in the Gas Phase with Fluorescent Nanodiamonds
papers.abstract: The quantitative detection of paramagnetic molecular oxygen (O2) in gas mixtures using optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR) from negatively charged nitrogen-vacancy (NV-) centers in fluorescent nanodiamonds is described. Fluorescent nanodiamonds approximately 70 nm in diameter were deposited on the glass surface of a microfluidic channel, and the oxygen concentration varied from 0 to 100% (0 to 760 mmHg O2 partial pressure) by mixing O2 and N2 gases at ambient pressure. Continuous-wave (CW) ODMR contrast was measured using a double-modulation (lock-in) detection scheme applied to both optical excitation and microwave drives. The ODMR contrast decreases linearly with oxygen partial pressure, with a sensitivity coefficient k of (-10.1 +/- 0.3) x 10^-4 % mmHg^-1. The oxygen detection limit of the experimental setup was estimated to be approximately 8 mmHg O2 partial pressure (corresponding to about 1% O2 in the gas mixture). Cycling of the content of O2 in the gas mixture in the range of 0-5% revealed slight hysteresis and corresponding repeatability of 0.006 in percent ODMR contrast. The observed fluorescence quenching and relatively slow response (ranging from several to tens of minutes) upon changes in oxygen concentration suggest that physisorption of gas molecules on the nanodiamond surfaces contributes to equilibration dynamics. The applicability of the nanodiamond-based oxygen quantum sensor was further demonstrated by detecting transient bursts of molecular oxygen generated by enzyme-catalyzed decomposition of hydrogen peroxide.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR)”、“continuous-wave (CW) ODMR contrast”、“double-modulation (lock-in) detection scheme”以及实验测量与数据描述。；研究对象：气相中的顺磁性分子氧（O₂），使用荧光纳米金刚石中的带负电氮-空位（NV⁻）中心作为量子传感器进行定量检测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 连续波ODMR对比度随氧气分压线性下降，灵敏度系数k为(-10.1 ± 0.3) × 10⁻⁴ % mmHg⁻¹，检测限约为8 mmHg O₂分压（约1% O₂）。氧气浓度变化时观察到荧光淬灭和较慢的响应时间（数分钟至数十分钟），表明气体分子在纳米金刚石表面的物理吸附主导了平衡动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：连续波ODMR对比度随氧气分压线性下降，灵敏度系数k为(-10.1 ± 0.3) × 10⁻⁴ % mmHg⁻¹，检测限约为8 mmHg O₂分压（约1% O₂）。氧气浓度变化时观察到荧光淬灭和较慢的响应时间（数分钟至数十分钟），表明气体分子在纳米金刚石表面的物理吸附主导了平衡动力学。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验采用直径约70 nm的荧光纳米金刚石沉积在微流控通道玻璃表面，通过混合O₂和N₂气体在常压下改变氧气浓度（0–100%，对应0–760 mmHg O₂分压）。使用双调制（锁相）检测方案同时调制光激发和微波驱动，测量连续波ODMR对比度。还通过酶催化过氧化氢分解产生的瞬时氧气爆发验证了传感器的适用性。

papers.title: Fracture energy of 6H-SiC at the microscale: effects of testing geometry and notch preparation
papers.abstract: Micromechanical testing enables small-scale fracture energy measurements, but values depend strongly on geometry and specimen preparation. Here, the fracture energy of the single-crystal 6H-SiC {10-10} plane was measured using microscale double cantilever beam (DCB) and single cantilever beam (SCB) geometries. DCBs showed stable crack growth under displacement control and obtained 7.5 +- 0.3 J/m2. In contrast, SCBs notched by a Ga focused ion beam gave fracture energies over twice this value, indicating Ga implantation and near-notch residual stresses. Increasing the final notching current increased the measured fracture energy further. Although near-cryogenic notching limited ion-beam-induced damage, it did not reconcile SCB-derived values with DCB test results. Vacuum annealing substantially lowered the fracture energy and brought SCB results into close agreement with DCB measurements, whereas annealing in argon was less effective. Our findings highlight the importance of careful sample preparation and testing geometry selection for reliable fracture property measurement in ceramic materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了具体的微机械测试（micromechanical testing）和样品制备方法，并给出了定量测量结果（如7.5 ± 0.3 J/m²）。；研究对象：单晶6H-SiC的{10-10}晶面在微尺度下的断裂能（fracture energy）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 微尺度下6H-SiC的断裂能测量值强烈依赖于测试几何结构和样品制备方式：双悬臂梁（DCB）测得7.5 J/m²，而单悬臂梁（SCB）因镓离子注入和近缺口残余应力导致测量值翻倍；真空退火可消除此偏差，使SCB结果与DCB一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：微尺度下6H-SiC的断裂能测量值强烈依赖于测试几何结构和样品制备方式：双悬臂梁（DCB）测得7.5 J/m²，而单悬臂梁（SCB）因镓离子注入和近缺口残余应力导致测量值翻倍；真空退火可消除此偏差，使SCB结果与DCB一致。；创新点：系统揭示了微尺度断裂能测量中测试几何结构（DCB vs. SCB）和FIB制备条件（刻蚀电流、退火气氛）对6H-SiC断裂能结果的显著影响，并发现真空退火可有效消除由Ga注入引起的测量偏差。
papers.method_zh: 采用微尺度双悬臂梁（DCB）和单悬臂梁（SCB）几何结构进行断裂能测量；使用镓聚焦离子束（Ga FIB）制备缺口，并改变最终刻蚀电流；采用近低温刻蚀和真空/氩气退火处理以控制离子束损伤。

papers.title: RamanGPT: Bidirectional Mapping Between Crystal Structures and Raman Spectra with Graph Neural Networks and Generative Transformers
papers.abstract: Raman spectroscopy is one of the most accessible vibrational probes in materials laboratories, but its forward problem (structure to spectrum) is bottlenecked by the cost of density functional perturbation theory, and its inverse problem (spectrum to structure) typically relies on retrieval against curated references. We introduce RamanGPT, a deep-learning framework that addresses both directions for crystalline inorganic materials. The forward model, an Atomistic Line Graph Neural Network (ALIGNN), is trained on the 5{,}099-material Computational Raman Database and predicts 200-bin spectra over 50-1000~cm$^{-1}$ with 42.5\% having a cosine similarity greater than or equal to 0.354 suggesting qualitative features of the target spectrum. The model also shows some qualitative agreement with the approximate features and appearance of similar relative intensity of the modes to an experimental measurement of metallic 1T VSe$_{2}$, a system absent from the training set. The inverse model fine-tunes a large language model via Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation on Raman-plus-formula prompts, recovering lattice parameters with mean absolute errors of 1.14-2.16~Å and reduced-formula consistency of 86.8\% on 508 held-out materials. A cosine-similarity matcher and an inverse$\rightarrow$relax$\rightarrow$forward consistency loop are deployed at https://atomgpt.org/raman.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：deep-learning framework, Graph Neural Networks, Generative Transformers, 训练数据库）；研究对象：晶体无机材料的拉曼光谱与晶体结构之间的双向映射（正向：结构→光谱；逆向：光谱→结构）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: RamanGPT框架实现了从晶体结构预测拉曼光谱（正向）以及从拉曼光谱反推晶体结构参数（逆向）的双向深度学习映射，逆向模型在508种材料上实现了86.8%的简化化学式一致性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：RamanGPT框架实现了从晶体结构预测拉曼光谱（正向）以及从拉曼光谱反推晶体结构参数（逆向）的双向深度学习映射，逆向模型在508种材料上实现了86.8%的简化化学式一致性。；创新点：首次在同一深度学习框架中同时解决拉曼光谱的正向预测（替代密度泛函微扰理论）和逆向结构检索（替代基于参考数据库的匹配），并利用大语言模型实现从光谱到晶格参数的直接回归。
papers.method_zh: 正向模型采用原子线图神经网络（ALIGNN）在5099种材料的计算拉曼数据库上训练；逆向模型通过量化低秩适配（QLoRA）微调大语言模型，结合拉曼光谱和化学式提示进行预测；并部署了余弦相似度匹配器和逆向→弛豫→正向一致性循环。

papers.title: Continuous limit of a discrete stochastic model of cell migration
papers.abstract: We analytically derive the continuous limit of the Cellular Potts Model (CPM) for a one-dimensional cell subjected to constant and run-and-tumble driving forces. By coarse-graining the discrete lattice dynamics, we obtain the Fokker-Planck equations governing the cell's size and center-of-mass position. We show that in the low-force regime, the cell dynamics are accurately described by an overdamped Langevin equation. Beyond this regime, we expose intrinsic algorithmic artifacts, including a force-dependent diffusion coefficient, a non-linear force-velocity relationship, and the breakdown of the Einstein relation. We demonstrate that replacing the conventional Metropolis update rule with Glauber dynamics significantly mitigates these artifacts, broadening the physically valid parameter space. Our exact results bridge the gap between lattice-based simulations and continuous active matter models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytically derive、coarse-graining、Fokker-Planck equations、Langevin equation。；研究对象：一维细胞在恒定力和“run-and-tumble”驱动力下的迁移行为，具体基于Cellular Potts Model (CPM) 的连续极限。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低力区，细胞动力学可由过阻尼朗之万方程准确描述；在高力区，CPM存在固有算法伪影（如力依赖的扩散系数、非线性力-速度关系、爱因斯坦关系失效），而采用Glauber动力学替代传统Metropolis更新规则可显著缓解这些伪影。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低力区，细胞动力学可由过阻尼朗之万方程准确描述；在高力区，CPM存在固有算法伪影（如力依赖的扩散系数、非线性力-速度关系、爱因斯坦关系失效），而采用Glauber动力学替代传统Metropolis更新规则可显著缓解这些伪影。；创新点：首次严格推导了CPM在连续极限下的解析形式，揭示了离散算法在高力区引入的非物理伪影，并提出了通过更换更新规则来拓宽物理有效参数空间的方案。
papers.method_zh: 通过粗粒化离散晶格动力学，解析推导出控制细胞大小和质心位置的Fokker-Planck方程，并对比Metropolis与Glauber两种更新规则下的连续极限行为。

papers.title: Demonstrating magnetic memory in iron-rhodium structures using a quantum diamond microscope
papers.abstract: Iron-rhodium (FeRh) has a first-order phase transition near room temperature between antiferromagnetic (AFM) and ferromagnetic (FM) phases, making it a promising material for magnetic memory technologies like heat-assisted magnetic recording (HAMR). It has a comparatively sharper phase transition and lower writing temperature than alternative materials, implying less thermal engineering constraints and an increase in write/read head lifetime. Despite great effort, however, AFM-based magnetic memory using FeRh has not yet been realized. Here, we employ both wide-field and scanning nanoscale quantum diamond microscopes (QDMs) to image directly the magnetic field of a patterned FeRh thin film structure under ambient conditions, demonstrating a magnetic recording technique that is reliable and robust. We experimentally identify coupling between the Néel and magnetization vector directions; and also, that the magnetic orientation of the FM phase uniquely determines the Néel vector in the AFM phase, due to pinned uncompensated magnetic moments (UMMs) in the FeRh structure. Thus, the magnetic orientation is maintained when the system is cycled between AFM and FM phases, providing the foundation for a practical, AFM-based magnetic memory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：demonstrating, image directly, experimentally identify, using a quantum diamond microscope。；研究对象：铁-铑（FeRh）薄膜结构中的反铁磁（AFM）与铁磁（FM）相变及其在磁存储中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验证实FeRh结构中反铁磁相的奈尔矢量方向由铁磁相的磁化方向唯一确定，且该磁取向在AFM与FM相之间循环时保持不变，从而为基于反铁磁的磁存储器提供了基础。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验证实FeRh结构中反铁磁相的奈尔矢量方向由铁磁相的磁化方向唯一确定，且该磁取向在AFM与FM相之间循环时保持不变，从而为基于反铁磁的磁存储器提供了基础。；创新点：首次实验实现了基于FeRh的反铁磁磁存储技术，并揭示了未补偿磁矩（UMMs）导致的奈尔矢量与磁化矢量之间的耦合机制。
papers.method_zh: 使用宽场和扫描纳米级量子金刚石显微镜（QDM），在环境条件下直接成像图案化FeRh薄膜结构的磁场。

papers.title: Mott transition of photons: quantum Monte Carlo study of Gross-Neveu criticality in a cavity
papers.abstract: The Hubbard model on the honeycomb lattice is a pristine realisation of a semimetal-to-insulator Mott transition belonging to the Gross-Neveu O(3) universality class. We couple this system to a single linearly polarised cavity photon mode. The light-matter coupling is such that the photon number remains an intensive quantity as is the case for an empty cavity. For this interacting light-matter model, we formulate a negative-sign-free fermion quantum Monte Carlo algorithm that allows for bias-free results on finite system sizes. Our numerical results show that the coupling to the cavity is irrelevant at criticality, even at strong electron-photon coupling. On the other hand, we observe, and show analytically, that the photon spectral function couples to the optical conductivity of the electronic system. The cavity photons thereby undergo a Mott transition, and the photon spectral function acts as a contact-free non-invasive probe for Mott criticality.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：quantum Monte Carlo（量子蒙特卡洛）、analytical（解析分析）、numerical results（数值结果）。；研究对象：耦合到单个线性极化腔光子模式的蜂窝晶格Hubbard模型，研究其中的半金属-绝缘体Mott相变（属于Gross-Neveu O(3)普适类）以及腔光子的Mott相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在临界点处，电子-光子耦合是无关的（irrelevant），即使强耦合下也不改变临界行为；同时，光子谱函数与电子系统的光导率耦合，导致腔光子自身经历Mott相变，光子谱函数可作为无接触、非侵入的探针来探测Mott临界性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在临界点处，电子-光子耦合是无关的（irrelevant），即使强耦合下也不改变临界行为；同时，光子谱函数与电子系统的光导率耦合，导致腔光子自身经历Mott相变，光子谱函数可作为无接触、非侵入的探针来探测Mott临界性。；创新点：首次在腔量子电动力学（cavity QED）框架下，通过量子蒙特卡洛方法严格证明光子与电子耦合在Mott临界点处是无关的，并揭示光子谱函数可作为探测Mott相变的非侵入式探针。摘要未突出说明与先前工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用无负符号问题的费米子量子蒙特卡洛算法（negative-sign-free fermion quantum Monte Carlo），在有限系统尺寸上进行无偏数值模拟，并结合解析分析。

papers.title: Mechanochemical Nano-Writing of an Atomically Thin Metal
papers.abstract: Mechanical energy accelerates many physicochemical processes, including materials syntheses that are hard to produce with thermal energy alone. However, physical understanding connecting applied mechanical forces with internal stresses and ensuing reaction mechanisms is lacking. Here we demonstrate mechanical force-enabled synthesis and nanoscale patterning to metallize a two-dimensional (2D) material, producing an atomically-thin superconducting material. Localized force applied by atomic force microscope tips to van der Waals (vdW) encapsulated stacks of 2D bilayer MoTe2 and adjacent source Pd guides 2D Pd7MoTe2 growth with 50 nm lateral resolution. Force accelerates reaction kinetics exponentially per Eyring's stress-assisted thermal activation model, reducing synthesis temperatures from ~200 °C to near-room temperature. Finite element simulations, density functional theory, and ab-initio grand canonical Monte Carlo calculations show that tip-induced compression facilitates Pd chemisorption to tensile-strained MoTe2 that converts to uniform Pd7MoTe2. This demonstrates a new, generalizable paradigm for nanoscale synthesis of quantum materials, and high-precision engineering of superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：demonstrate, atomic force microscope tips, synthesis, patterning）；研究对象：二维材料金属化，具体为通过机械力诱导二硫化钼（MoTe₂）与钯（Pd）反应，生成原子级厚度的超导材料Pd₇MoTe₂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过原子力显微镜针尖施加局域机械力，可在室温附近实现二维材料MoTe₂的金属化相变，并精确制备出原子级厚度的超导材料，其空间分辨率可达50纳米。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过原子力显微镜针尖施加局域机械力，可在室温附近实现二维材料MoTe₂的金属化相变，并精确制备出原子级厚度的超导材料，其空间分辨率可达50纳米。；创新点：首次展示了利用机械力（而非传统热退火）在纳米尺度上直接合成并图案化二维量子材料，将合成温度从约200°C降至近室温，为量子材料的纳米级制备和超导性的高精度调控提供了新范式。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用原子力显微镜（AFM）针尖对范德华异质结（2D双层MoTe₂与Pd源）施加局域应力；理论上结合有限元模拟、密度泛函理论（DFT）和从头算巨正则蒙特卡洛（ab-initio grand canonical Monte Carlo）计算，揭示应力辅助的热激活反应机制。

papers.title: Enhanced superconductivity in atomically thin noble metals: From quantum confinement to interface-induced Lifshitz transition
papers.abstract: Unlocking superconductivity in intrinsically non-superconducting noble metals (Au, Ag, Cu) represents a fundamental challenge in low-dimensional physics. While quantum confinement in the atomically thin limit is known to trigger emergent superconductivity, strategies to amplify this marginal effect to experimentally accessible temperatures remain a key open question. Using first-principles calculations, we establish a unified framework linking intrinsic confinement effects with interface engineering in noble metal films. We reveal that intrinsic superconductivity is element-specific: it is suppressed in Ag by a stiff phonon spectrum, but emerges in trilayer Cu ($T_{\rm C} \approx 0.78$ K) and pentalayer Au ($0.63$ K) driven by confinement-induced density-of-states (DOS) enhancement and phonon softening, respectively. In h-BN/Cu(111) heterostructures, $T_{\rm C}$ is critically dictated by the interfacial stacking configuration. We identify the thermodynamically stable N-bonded interface as a reliable platform for accessible superconductivity ($T_{\rm C} \approx 3.23$ K), whereas manipulating the system into a metastable B-bonded configuration boosts $T_{\rm C}$ to $7.00$ K. This enhancement originates from a B-bonded-induced Lifshitz transition, where the Fermi surface forms a tangential contact with the Brillouin zone boundary at the M point, enhancing electron-phonon coupling beyond DOS effects. Our work unifies the understanding of intrinsic two-dimensional superconductivity with atomistic interface design, offering a blueprint for functionalizing noble metals as emergent superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：原子级薄层贵金属（Au、Ag、Cu）及其与六方氮化硼（h-BN）构成的异质结中的超导电性，以及由量子限域和界面诱导的Lifshitz相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在原子级薄层贵金属中，超导电性具有元素特异性：Ag因声子谱刚硬而被抑制，三层Cu（Tc≈0.78 K）和五层Au（Tc≈0.63 K）分别由态密度增强和声子软化驱动产生超导。在h-BN/Cu(111)异质结中，通过界面堆叠构型调控可实现Tc从3.23 K（N键合界面）到7.00 K（B键合界面）的显著提升，后者源于B键合诱导的Lifshitz相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在原子级薄层贵金属中，超导电性具有元素特异性：Ag因声子谱刚硬而被抑制，三层Cu（Tc≈0.78 K）和五层Au（Tc≈0.63 K）分别由态密度增强和声子软化驱动产生超导。在h-BN/Cu(111)异质结中，通过界面堆叠构型调控可实现Tc从3.23 K（N键合界面）到7.00 K（B键合界面）的显著提升，后者源于B键合诱导的Lifshitz相变。；创新点：建立了将量子限域效应与界面工程相统一的理论框架，揭示了界面堆叠构型（N键合 vs. B键合）通过诱导Lifshitz相变（费米面与布里渊区边界M点相切）来大幅增强电子-声子耦合的机制，超越了单纯的态密度增强效应。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），具体用于分析电子态密度、声子谱、电子-声子耦合以及费米面拓扑结构。

papers.title: Chirality-resolved spectroscopy of Caroli-de Gennes-Matricon states in multiband FeTe$_{1-x}$Se$_{x}$ superconductors
papers.abstract: We employ terahertz Faraday magneto-optical spectroscopy to probe the relaxation dynamics of quantized helical Caroli-de Gennes-Matricon (CdGM) states in epitaxial FeTe$_{1-x}$Se$_x$ thin films, nodeless multiband superconductors with short coherence lengths in the moderately clean limit. By exploiting polarization-selective optical transitions, we directly resolve the helicity and band origin of vortex-core quasiparticles. We observe long-lived CdGM resonances with opposite circular polarizations for electron- and hole-like bands. This enables independent, band-resolved determination of quasiparticle lifetimes, vortex masses, coherence lengths, and upper critical fields, and reveals their systematic evolution with isovalent substitution. The results establish terahertz magneto-optics as a direct probe of helical vortex-core excitations and provide dynamical evidence for multiband CdGM states in iron-based superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：terahertz Faraday magneto-optical spectroscopy（太赫兹法拉第磁光光谱）、polarization-selective optical transitions（偏振选择性光学跃迁）。；研究对象：多带铁基超导体 FeTe$_{1-x}$Se$_x$ 外延薄膜中的 Caroli-de Gennes-Matricon (CdGM) 涡旋芯束缚态，具体关注其手性分辨的弛豫动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过偏振选择性光学跃迁，直接分辨了电子型与空穴型能带对应的涡旋芯准粒子的手性（螺旋性），并实现了对多带 CdGM 态的能带分辨动力学测量，揭示了其随等价位取代的系统演化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过偏振选择性光学跃迁，直接分辨了电子型与空穴型能带对应的涡旋芯准粒子的手性（螺旋性），并实现了对多带 CdGM 态的能带分辨动力学测量，揭示了其随等价位取代的系统演化。；创新点：首次利用太赫兹磁光光谱直接探测多带铁基超导体中涡旋芯激发的手性，并实现了对电子型与空穴型能带中 CdGM 态的独立、能带分辨的动力学表征（包括准粒子寿命、涡旋质量、相干长度和上临界场）。
papers.method_zh: 太赫兹法拉第磁光光谱（terahertz Faraday magneto-optical spectroscopy），利用圆偏振光选择性激发不同手性的 CdGM 态。

papers.title: Two-mode collapse and revival of quantum coherent state in a tilted optical lattice
papers.abstract: Collective dynamics is an important out-of-equilibrium feature of quantum coherent states and usually reflects the intrinsic properties of the state. Collapse and revival (CR) dynamics of phase coherence is a well-known example for bosonic coherent states, which is usually induced by applying a quench. Previous studies have shown that the CR frequency is governed solely by interactions, even in the presence of a tilt quench. However, whether such interaction-dominated oscillation is a universal feature remains unknown. In this work, we show that an ensemble of one-dimensional bosons can undergo two-mode CR, with frequencies set by both the interaction and the tilt, particularly when the tilt is weaker than the interaction. The newly discovered tilt mode is enabled by tunneling between lattice sites. When the two modes coexist, the amplitudes of both modes exhibit universal linear scaling for various tilts. These findings clarify the general features of CR dynamics in tilted lattice models and the underlying mechanism, and provide deeper insight into collective dynamics in correlated systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中未提及实验或计算手段，主要基于理论分析和模型推导（如“show that an ensemble of one-dimensional bosons can undergo two-mode CR”）。；研究对象：倾斜光晶格中的一维玻色子量子相干态，具体研究其集体动力学行为中的塌缩与恢复（collapse and revival, CR）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当倾斜强度弱于相互作用时，系统会出现由相互作用和倾斜共同决定的双模塌缩与恢复动力学，其中新发现的“倾斜模”由晶格间隧穿驱动；两种模式的振幅随倾斜强度呈普适线性标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当倾斜强度弱于相互作用时，系统会出现由相互作用和倾斜共同决定的双模塌缩与恢复动力学，其中新发现的“倾斜模”由晶格间隧穿驱动；两种模式的振幅随倾斜强度呈普适线性标度。；创新点：揭示了在倾斜光晶格中，塌缩与恢复频率并非仅由相互作用主导（如以往研究所认为），而是当倾斜较弱时会出现由隧穿效应导致的第二个频率模式（倾斜模），并发现两种模式振幅的普适线性标度行为。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于倾斜光晶格模型（tilted optical lattice）中的一维玻色子系综，通过解析或半解析方法研究量子相干态的塌缩与恢复动力学。

papers.title: Molecular neutron spectroscopy techniques applied to ceramics $α$-SiC and $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$
papers.abstract: Neutron spectroscopy is a powerful technique for determining the vibrational states of matter. Instruments with fixed geometry may measure inelastic scattering at a limited set of angles, producing a 1-D spectrum $S(ω)$. Such measurements are usually simulated in a DOS-like semi-analytic incoherent approximation, well-established for study of bending/stretching modes in molecular crystals. In this work we empirically test the simulation method for two ceramics with industrial electronic applications that act as "worst-case" systems. The phonon scattering from $α$-SiC and $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ is coherent, depends on momentum transfer $Q$ and sits in frequencies below the typical "fingerprint" range of molecular spectroscopy. Inelastic neutron-scattering measurements of powders were performed with two contrasting spectrometers at cryogenic and elevated temperatures, and simulations performed using a variety of density-functional approximations. We find that for 1-D powder spectra from a compact instrument, the approximate simulations are easily comparable with experimental spectra and give similar results to a more computationally-intensive numerical sampling of the coherent spectrum. Given the success with these systems, the approximate method appears to be suitable for modelling inelastic neutron scattering by harmonic phonons of almost any powder sample with this technique. When a $Q$-resolved instrument is used to collect the 2-D dynamical structure factor $S(Q,ω)$, numerical averaging is still required to capture phonon features. Our simulations of inelastic scattering from $α$-SiC in the 6H polytype using the PBEsol functional gave good agreement with the experiments. By contrast, the RSCAN functional gave the best agreement with the measured spectra of $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ and is recommended for future work on the lattice dynamics of this material.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。关键词：Inelastic neutron-scattering measurements、density-functional approximations、simulations。；研究对象：两种具有工业电子应用背景的陶瓷材料：α-SiC（6H多型）和β-Ga₂O₃，具体研究其声子振动谱。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于紧凑型仪器获得的1维粉末谱，基于非相干近似的模拟方法能够与实验谱良好吻合，且与更耗时的相干谱数值采样结果相似；对于β-Ga₂O₃，RSCAN泛函给出的模拟结果与实验最佳吻合，推荐用于该材料未来晶格动力学研究。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于紧凑型仪器获得的1维粉末谱，基于非相干近似的模拟方法能够与实验谱良好吻合，且与更耗时的相干谱数值采样结果相似；对于β-Ga₂O₃，RSCAN泛函给出的模拟结果与实验最佳吻合，推荐用于该材料未来晶格动力学研究。；创新点：将通常用于分子晶体弯曲/伸缩模式研究的非相干近似模拟方法，首次系统应用于两种具有相干散射、低频率声子特征的工业陶瓷“最坏情况”体系，并验证了其适用性。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验上：使用两种不同构型的中子谱仪（固定几何紧凑型仪器与Q分辨仪器），在低温和高温下对粉末样品进行非弹性中子散射测量，获得1维谱S(ω)和2维动力学结构因子S(Q,ω)。计算上：采用多种密度泛函近似（包括PBEsol和RSCAN泛函）进行声子模拟，并对比了半解析非相干近似与全数值相干谱采样的结果。

papers.title: Reversible Superdense Ordering of Tetragonal Lithium in a Layered Material
papers.abstract: Understanding lithium (Li) ordering and dynamics is foundational in energy storage. X-ray based experimental methods do not simultaneously provide atomic structure information together with chemical composition and local bonding information for lithium in solids. Here we employ scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) and combine imaging, spectroscopy, and diffraction within a single experiment, to observe, in situ, an all-solid-state electrochemical cell. By integrating multimodal STEM with other complementary techniques, we report a complete mapping of lithium intercalation in a layered system, LaTe3. We identify three ordered phases of LixLaTe3 with x ranging from 1/3 to 3 with in-plane strain of up to 5%. At a very high lithium concentration of Li3LaTe3, we discover an unexpected three-layer, superdense lithium phase with tetragonal symmetry occupying the van der Waals gap. This represents a new Li phase that is reversible. Our multimodal approach thus enables complete tracking of lithium ordering and dynamics, important for next-generation energy storage applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词包括“scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM)”、“imaging, spectroscopy, and diffraction”、“in situ”、“all-solid-state electrochemical cell”。；研究对象：锂在层状材料LaTe₃中的有序排列与嵌入行为，具体研究LixLaTe₃体系（x从1/3到3）中的锂有序相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在极高锂浓度Li₃LaTe₃中，发现了一种可逆的、具有四方对称性的三层超密锂相，该相占据范德瓦尔斯间隙，且伴随高达5%的面内应变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在极高锂浓度Li₃LaTe₃中，发现了一种可逆的、具有四方对称性的三层超密锂相，该相占据范德瓦尔斯间隙，且伴随高达5%的面内应变。；创新点：首次通过多模态STEM方法，在单一实验中同时获取锂的原子结构、化学组成和局域键合信息，并完整追踪了层状体系中锂的嵌入过程，发现了此前未知的可逆超密四方锂相。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM），在同一实验中结合成像、能谱和衍射技术，对全固态电化学电池进行原位观测，并辅以其他互补技术进行多模态分析。

papers.title: Constraint-Enhanced Physical Search through Correlation Matching
papers.abstract: Physical systems do not merely add noise to search processes; they impose constraints that generate structured correlations. We propose a principle of constraint-enhanced physical search in which temporal correlations in exploration are matched to constraint-induced spatial correlations in the update dynamics. Using a minimal tug-of-war bandit model (TOW), we show that a conservation law converts local observations into differential evidence across alternatives, while a temporally correlated drive controls the order of exploration.
