Search efficiency is improved not by stronger randomness or by maximal anti-correlation, but by matching the temporal correlation to the physical update scale that converts feedback into evidence. A scaling estimate identifies the update-noise-to-contrast ratio as the leading parameter that limits how strongly temporal anti-correlation can be used. The results suggest a general organizing principle for physical search: constraints and fluctuations can generate structured spatiotemporal correlations, and efficient exploration emerges when these correlations are matched to the update dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose a principle、using a minimal model、scaling estimate。；研究对象：物理搜索过程（physical search process），具体以“拔河式强盗模型”（tug-of-war bandit model, TOW）为研究对象，探讨约束（如守恒律）如何通过时空关联性影响搜索效率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 搜索效率的提升并非来自更强的随机性或最大反关联，而是通过将探索的时间关联性与物理更新动力学中反馈转化为证据的空间关联性相匹配来实现。约束（如守恒律）能将局部观测转化为不同选项间的差分证据，从而增强搜索。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：搜索效率的提升并非来自更强的随机性或最大反关联，而是通过将探索的时间关联性与物理更新动力学中反馈转化为证据的空间关联性相匹配来实现。约束（如守恒律）能将局部观测转化为不同选项间的差分证据，从而增强搜索。；创新点：提出“约束增强物理搜索”（constraint-enhanced physical search）这一普适组织原则，强调约束与涨落可产生结构化的时空关联，而高效探索的关键在于将这些关联与更新动力学相匹配。摘要未突出说明与已有搜索理论（如经典强盗算法或随机游走）的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用最小化理论模型（tug-of-war bandit model）进行分析，通过解析缩放估计（scaling estimate）识别出“更新噪声-对比度比”（update-noise-to-contrast ratio）作为限制时间反关联强度的主导参数。

papers.title: Kinetics of Droplet Cloaking and Wetting Ridge Growth on Lubricated Polymer Brushes
papers.abstract: We investigate the kinetics of wetting ridge growth and droplet cloaking on lubricant-infused polymer brushes using a combination of experiments, molecular dynamics simulations, and theoretical modeling. We focus on three representative systems: DMSO-water on hexadecane-swollen PLMA (D-H), water on hexadecane-swollen PLMA (W-H), and water on PDMS (W-S). The dynamics are governed by the interplay between interfacial thermodynamics, brush elasticity, and transport of lubricant within the brush. Ridge growth is accompanied by the formation of depletion zones both beneath and outside the drop. This leads to a progressive slowdown governed by the need to transport lubricant through the brush. At sufficiently high swelling, we observe local separation of oil from the brush within the ridge, providing an additional mechanism for lubricant depletion. To rationalize these observations, we develop a continuum diffusion model based on the free energy of the brush and its coupling to the contact line. The model quantitatively captures the growth of the wetting ridge at intermediate and late times, demonstrating that the kinetics are largely controlled by diffusive transport within the brush.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验、分子动力学模拟、理论建模）。判断依据关键词：experiments, molecular dynamics simulations, theoretical modeling。；研究对象：润滑剂浸润聚合物刷上液滴的“隐形”（cloaking）动力学以及润湿脊（wetting ridge）的生长过程。具体体系包括：DMSO-水在十六烷溶胀的PLMA上（D-H）、水在十六烷溶胀的PLMA上（W-H）、水在PDMS上（W-S）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 润湿脊的生长动力学受限于润滑剂在聚合物刷内的扩散输运，且在高溶胀度下，脊内会发生油与刷的局部分离，进一步加剧润滑剂耗竭。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：润湿脊的生长动力学受限于润滑剂在聚合物刷内的扩散输运，且在高溶胀度下，脊内会发生油与刷的局部分离，进一步加剧润滑剂耗竭。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验（具体手段摘要未明确说明）、分子动力学模拟、基于刷自由能及其与接触线耦合的连续扩散模型。

papers.title: Ferroelectric-tunable quantum nonlinearity of chiral Bloch electrons in a moiré system
papers.abstract: Sliding ferroelectricity in van der Waals materials shows great potential for designing robust memory devices. However, its thermodynamic behaviors and the coupling with certain quantum effects remain largely unexplored. Here, we demonstrate ferroelectric control over quantum nonlinear transport in a hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) encapsulated twisted double-bilayer graphene moiré heterostructure. The ferroelectricity is attributed to the presence of rhombohedral stacking in the top hBN, confirmed by both electrical transport and optical second harmonic generation (SHG) measurements. Remarkably, the polarization magnitude remains temperature-independent across 1.7-200 K, while nucleation time exhibits thermally activated behavior, decreasing with increasing temperature. Furthermore, we demonstrate a ferroelectric-switchable nonlinear Hall effect, attributed to the chiral scattering induced by Berry curvature, with outstanding fatigue-resistant and nonvolatility, demonstrating direct coupling between sliding ferroelectricity and quantum geometric properties. Our results establish sliding ferroelectrics as a platform for exploring electrically programmable Berry curvature physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“electrical transport and optical second harmonic generation (SHG) measurements”等实验手段，并描述了具体实验现象（如极化强度随温度变化、 nucleation time 行为等）。；研究对象：六方氮化硼（hBN）封装的扭转双层石墨烯莫尔异质结（twisted double-bilayer graphene moiré heterostructure）中的滑动铁电性及其与量子非线性输运的耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在hBN封装的扭转双层石墨烯莫尔异质结中，实现了滑动铁电性对量子非线性输运（特别是可开关的非线性霍尔效应）的铁电控制，并展示了该铁电性与贝里曲率诱导的手性散射之间的直接耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在hBN封装的扭转双层石墨烯莫尔异质结中，实现了滑动铁电性对量子非线性输运（特别是可开关的非线性霍尔效应）的铁电控制，并展示了该铁电性与贝里曲率诱导的手性散射之间的直接耦合。；创新点：首次在莫尔体系中实验演示了滑动铁电性对量子几何性质（贝里曲率）的直接调控，实现了铁电可切换的非线性霍尔效应，并展示了其抗疲劳性和非易失性。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 电输运测量（electrical transport）和光学二次谐波产生（SHG）测量。通过这两种手段确认了顶部hBN中菱方堆叠的存在及铁电性，并研究了极化强度、成核时间等热力学行为。

papers.title: Multiscale Phase Separation in Chemophoretic Active Matter
papers.abstract: Nonreciprocal interactions in active matter provide interesting structure and dynamics. Here we investigate chemophoretic systems in which nonreciprocity arises from the asymmetric coupling between agents: first species produces certain chemicals and the other phoretically responds to it. This leads to phase separation at varying scales. Our study uncovers a re-entrant steady-state phase diagram as the nature of the coupling changes from chemoattractive to chemorepulsive character. Chemoattraction provides sustained domain growth, leading to macrophase separation via cluster coalescence. Aggregation in the chemorepulsive case, on the other hand, leads to a steady-state situation that displays phase separation only at a microscale, owing to strong caging effect and frequent fragmentation. The overall far-from-steady-state dynamics is quantified via calculations of growth exponents, cluster transition matrices, and mean-squared displacements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：investigate、calculations、growth exponents、cluster transition matrices、mean-squared displacements。；研究对象：化学泳动活性物质（chemophoretic active matter）中的多尺度相分离现象，具体研究由非互易耦合（非对称化学响应）驱动的活性粒子体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当耦合从化学吸引变为化学排斥时，体系出现重入稳态相图：化学吸引导致宏观相分离（持续团簇生长与合并），而化学排斥仅产生微观尺度的相分离（由于强笼蔽效应和频繁碎裂）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当耦合从化学吸引变为化学排斥时，体系出现重入稳态相图：化学吸引导致宏观相分离（持续团簇生长与合并），而化学排斥仅产生微观尺度的相分离（由于强笼蔽效应和频繁碎裂）。；创新点：揭示了化学泳动活性物质中因非互易耦合性质（吸引/排斥）变化而导致的相分离尺度从宏观到微观的转变，并发现了重入稳态相图。摘要未突出说明与已有活性物质相分离研究的具体区别。
papers.method_zh: 通过理论建模与数值计算，分析团簇生长指数、团簇转移矩阵和均方位移，量化远离稳态的动力学行为。

papers.title: Hierarchical crack patterns: Identification of crack generations
papers.abstract: Hierarchical crack patterns of various origins are ubiquitous in the world around us. We reduce the problem of classifying crack generations in an image of a part of the entire hierarchical crack pattern to the well-known topological sorting of a directed acyclic graph. The classification demonstrates robustness to reasonable shifts in the pattern image boundaries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：将问题“归约”为“拓扑排序”这一图论算法，属于理论建模与计算方法。；研究对象：层级裂纹图案（Hierarchical crack patterns），具体研究如何识别和分类裂纹图案中不同世代的裂纹。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将裂纹世代分类问题转化为有向无环图的拓扑排序问题，实现了对层级裂纹图案中裂纹世代的自动识别，且该方法对图像边界的合理移动具有鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将裂纹世代分类问题转化为有向无环图的拓扑排序问题，实现了对层级裂纹图案中裂纹世代的自动识别，且该方法对图像边界的合理移动具有鲁棒性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 图论中的拓扑排序算法（Topological sorting of a directed acyclic graph）。将裂纹图案中的裂纹视为节点，裂纹间的交叉或连接关系视为有向边，从而构建有向无环图。

papers.title: Microscopic derivation of the microstretch theory for carbon nanotubes
papers.abstract: Twisted carbon nanotubes support phonons involving not only torsion, naturally associated with microrotation, but also radial breathing, which requires a scalar stretch degree of freedom. We derive an effective microstretch theory for these modes starting from nonlinear elasticity on a cylindrical surface. By linearizing the equation of motion around a uniformly twisted equilibrium configuration, we obtain the dynamical matrix for the twisting, longitudinal, and radial-breathing modes. This matrix coincides with that of a one-dimensional microstretch theory, and the corresponding elastic constants are expressed in terms of the Lamé constants, the nanotube radius, and the twist rate. The twist generates chiral couplings in the effective theory, which hybridize the three modes and open an anticrossing in the phonon dispersion. These results provide a microscopic basis for the microstretch description of phonons in twisted carbon nanotubes and clarify how structural chirality enters the effective couplings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：microscopic derivation、nonlinear elasticity、effective theory。；研究对象：扭曲碳纳米管中的声子模式，特别是扭转、纵向和径向呼吸模式，以及微拉伸理论对这些模式的描述。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从圆柱面上的非线性弹性理论出发，推导出扭曲碳纳米管中声子的有效微拉伸理论，揭示了扭转产生的手性耦合会杂化三种声子模式并在色散中打开反交叉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从圆柱面上的非线性弹性理论出发，推导出扭曲碳纳米管中声子的有效微拉伸理论，揭示了扭转产生的手性耦合会杂化三种声子模式并在色散中打开反交叉。；创新点：为扭曲碳纳米管中声子的微拉伸描述提供了微观基础，并阐明了结构手性如何进入有效耦合。
papers.method_zh: 基于非线性弹性理论，在圆柱面上建立模型，对均匀扭曲平衡构型附近的运动方程进行线性化，得到动力学矩阵，并将其与一维微拉伸理论对比，将弹性常数用拉梅常数、纳米管半径和扭曲率表示。

papers.title: Magnetic field effects on spin-split band and magnon transport in altermagnets and emergent compensated ferrimagnets
papers.abstract: In altermagnets and fully compensated ferrimagnets, not only the electron band but also the magnon band exhibits spin splitting without net magnetization, which enables thermal activation of the magnon spin current. Here, we theoretically investigate magnetic field effects on the magnon properties of these antiferromagnets in the presence of a weak easy-axis anisotropy which makes the collinear states robust against the magnetic field. For the altermagnet and compensated ferrimagnet, we analyze a 2 sublattice order in the $J_1$-$J_2$-$J_2^\prime$ model on the square lattice and a triple-${\bf Q}$ 12-sublattice order in the $J_1$-$J_3$ model on the kagome lattice, respectively, each accompanied by $d$-wave and $s$-wave spin splitting at zero field. It is shown that for positive (negative) magnetic field $H$ whose energy scale is smaller than the anisotropy gap, the up- and down-spin magnon bands are shifted to lower (higher) and higher (lower) energies, respectively, similarly to the Zeeman coupling in electron systems. In the altermagnet, with increasing field, the $d$-wave splitting tends to be deformed into the $s$-wave one, which is reflected as the change in the direction of the spin current generated by thermal gradient. In the compensated ferrimagnet, the $s$-wave nature, i.e., the population imbalance between the up- and down-spin magnons at $H=0$, results in an asymmetric field dependence of the longitudinal spin and thermal conductivities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“theoretically investigate”“we analyze”等表述，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：交变磁体（altermagnets）和完全补偿铁磁体（fully compensated ferrimagnets）中的自旋分裂能带与磁振子输运，具体分析了正方晶格上的 \(J_1\)-\(J_2\)-\(J_2^\prime\) 模型（两子格序）和 kagome 晶格上的 \(J_1\)-\(J_3\) 模型（三重-Q 12子格序）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弱易轴各向异性下，外加磁场会使交变磁体和补偿铁磁体中的自旋向上和向下磁振子能带发生类似电子塞曼效应的能量移动；交变磁体中d波自旋分裂随磁场增强逐渐变形为s波分裂，从而改变热梯度产生的自旋电流方向；补偿铁磁体中零场下的s波自旋布居不对称导致纵向自旋和热导率呈现非对称的磁场依赖关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在弱易轴各向异性下，外加磁场会使交变磁体和补偿铁磁体中的自旋向上和向下磁振子能带发生类似电子塞曼效应的能量移动；交变磁体中d波自旋分裂随磁场增强逐渐变形为s波分裂，从而改变热梯度产生的自旋电流方向；补偿铁磁体中零场下的s波自旋布居不对称导致纵向自旋和热导率呈现非对称的磁场依赖关系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于两子格和12子格自旋模型的线性自旋波理论，考虑弱易轴各向异性，计算磁场对磁振子能带、自旋电流方向以及纵向自旋/热导率的影响。

papers.title: Predicting the conditions for observing the Mpemba effect
papers.abstract: The Mpemba effect, a counterintuitive phenomenon where a hotter system relaxes faster than a colder one, has been widely observed in various nonequilibrium systems. Despite this progress, the fundamental structural features of the energy landscape required for its emergence remain a subject of debate. In this study, we investigate the conditions for the Mpemba effect within one-dimensional overdamped Langevin dynamics. We classify the potential landscapes based on the presence of single or double wells, their symmetry properties, and the existence of walls. We establish that the existence of the effect is primarily driven by the presence of boundaries, either hard or soft, rather than the specific internal structure of the potential landscape, such as metastability or the number of minima. By employing a spectral decomposition of the Fokker-Planck operator, we analyze the behavior of the first nontrivial eigenmode and demonstrate that its derivative acts as a Dirac delta peak in the low-temperature regime. This helps us elucidate the mechanism underlying the Mpemba effect: it appears as the interplay between this behavior and the initial population dynamics in a non-trivial way induced by the presence of the wall. Our analysis provides a unified classification across single- and double-well potentials, highlighting the crucial role of boundary conditions and asymmetry. Furthermore, we demonstrate that this framework allows for the engineering of potential landscapes capable of producing multistage Mpemba transitions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：overdamped Langevin dynamics、spectral decomposition、Fokker-Planck operator。；研究对象：Mpemba效应（热系统比冷系统更快弛豫的反直觉现象）在一维过阻尼朗之万动力学中的出现条件。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Mpemba效应的出现主要由势能景观的边界（硬边界或软边界）驱动，而非其内部结构（如亚稳态或极小值数量）；边界的存在与初始种群动力学的非平凡相互作用是效应产生的机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Mpemba效应的出现主要由势能景观的边界（硬边界或软边界）驱动，而非其内部结构（如亚稳态或极小值数量）；边界的存在与初始种群动力学的非平凡相互作用是效应产生的机制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用Fokker-Planck算子的谱分解方法，分析第一非平凡本征模的行为，并研究其导数在低温极限下作为狄拉克δ峰的特性，从而分类单阱与双阱势能景观。

papers.title: Populating topologically protected edge states of a Chern insulator with the cold-atom elevator scheme and measurements
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional Chern insulators support topologically protected, chiral edge currents, and these can be detected in experiments with ultracold atoms in optical lattices. It has previously been shown that one can populate a selected group of edge states of a Chern insulator by transferring particles from a reservoir. Here, we numerically investigate the effect of performing an instantaneous, projective measurement on the reservoir before the reservoir is discarded. In this way, the final state of the system is pure and described by a wavefunction. We also show that quite likely measurement outcomes can help to increase the final number or percentage of particles in the chiral edge states through postselection. Without the measurement step, the physics can be described in terms of single-particle physics. The measurement significantly complicates the description. By appropriately rewriting the analytical expressions, we show that measurement probabilities, expectation values, averages of expectation values, and purity can nevertheless be computed from the state before the measurement in a way that scales only linearly with the number of lattice sites for a fixed number of particles. This enables us to investigate a setup with, for instance, 14 particles and 198 lattice sites numerically. The approach applies generally to noninteracting, fermionic models that conserve the number of particles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：numerically investigate（数值研究）、analytical expressions（解析表达式）、noninteracting, fermionic models（无相互作用费米子模型）。；研究对象：陈绝缘体（Chern insulator）的拓扑保护边缘态，具体研究在超冷原子光晶格体系中，通过“冷原子升降机”方案填充这些边缘态的过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在将粒子从储层转移到陈绝缘体边缘态后，对储层进行瞬时投影测量，可以使系统最终处于纯态（由波函数描述），并且通过后选择（postselection）可能提高手性边缘态中的粒子数或比例。该测量过程虽然使描述复杂化，但通过重写解析表达式，可以仅以与格点数量线性相关的计算成本来获得测量概率、期望值等物理量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在将粒子从储层转移到陈绝缘体边缘态后，对储层进行瞬时投影测量，可以使系统最终处于纯态（由波函数描述），并且通过后选择（postselection）可能提高手性边缘态中的粒子数或比例。该测量过程虽然使描述复杂化，但通过重写解析表达式，可以仅以与格点数量线性相关的计算成本来获得测量概率、期望值等物理量。；创新点：提出并数值验证了一种通过“测量+后选择”来增加陈绝缘体手性边缘态粒子数或比例的新方案，并发展了一套高效的计算方法，使得对包含测量步骤的较大系统进行数值模拟成为可能。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟与解析推导相结合。具体而言，对无相互作用的费米子模型（粒子数守恒）进行数值研究，通过重写解析表达式来高效计算测量后的物理量，从而实现对包含14个粒子和198个格点的系统进行数值模拟。

papers.title: Epitaxial $\mathrm{Co_2MnSi}$ with intrinsic magnetocrystalline anisotropy as a route to bias-field-free nonlinear half-metal magnonics at the nanoscale
papers.abstract: Half-metallic Heusler compounds like $\mathrm{Co_2MnSi}$ allow to bridge magnonic and spintronic functionality for hybrid unconventional computing approaches with sought-after properties like 100% spin polarization and associated low Gilbert damping $α\leq 10^{-3}$. However, the desirable material parameters are inherently tied to the crystal lattice with a particularly critical dependence on structural order in $\mathrm{Co_2MnSi}$. To date, the successful fabrication of nanoscale devices with robust structural integrity remains yet a challenge, and consequently the impact of the material parameters on the resulting nonlinear spin-wave dynamics remains largely unexplored. Here, we report on a study of linear and nonlinear spin-wave dynamics in transversally magnetized $\mathrm{Co_2MnSi}$ waveguides with impeccable crystalline ordering. We show that epitaxial, $\mathrm{L2}_1$-ordered $\mathrm{Co_2MnSi}$ exhibits an intrinsic cubic anisotropy with first- and second-order contributions, stabilizing a magnetization alignment along the crystal $\langle110\rangle$ directions. We confirm the implication of an unaffected crystal structure resulting in preserved magnetic properties in the patterned structures. Herein, the persistent magnetocrystalline anisotropy reshapes the spin-wave dispersion which yields a first-order nonlinear instability suppression range extending over several GHz - even for vanishing bias fields. Moreover, the intrinsic magnetocrystalline anisotropy can be exploited to counteract shape demagnetization for a stabilized low bias field operation in the favourable Damon-Eshbach geometry with high group velocities and decay lengths. Together with the proven half-metallicity and ultralow Gilbert damping, this research establishes $\mathrm{Co_2MnSi}$ as a robust, scalable platform towards bias-field-free nonlinear half-metal magnonics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：epitaxial（外延）、report on a study of linear and nonlinear spin-wave dynamics（报告线性和非线性自旋波动力学研究）、patterned structures（图案化结构）。；研究对象：半金属Heusler化合物Co₂MnSi中的线性和非线性自旋波动力学，特别是其本征磁晶各向异性对纳米尺度非线性半金属磁子学的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 外延L2₁有序的Co₂MnSi具有本征立方各向异性（含一阶和二阶贡献），可稳定磁化沿晶体⟨110⟩方向排列；该各向异性可重塑自旋波色散，在零偏置场下实现数GHz的一阶非线性不稳定性抑制范围，并抵消形状退磁效应，从而在Damon-Eshbach几何构型中实现稳定的低偏置场操作。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：外延L2₁有序的Co₂MnSi具有本征立方各向异性（含一阶和二阶贡献），可稳定磁化沿晶体⟨110⟩方向排列；该各向异性可重塑自旋波色散，在零偏置场下实现数GHz的一阶非线性不稳定性抑制范围，并抵消形状退磁效应，从而在Damon-Eshbach几何构型中实现稳定的低偏置场操作。；创新点：首次在纳米尺度图案化Co₂MnSi结构中证实本征磁晶各向异性可有效抑制非线性不稳定性，并实现无偏置场（bias-field-free）的稳定自旋波传播，为构建可扩展的半金属磁子学平台提供了实验依据。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（epitaxial）生长L2₁有序Co₂MnSi薄膜，制备横向磁化波导（transversally magnetized waveguides），通过实验研究线性和非线性自旋波动力学，并结合晶体结构表征确认图案化后磁性能保持不变。

papers.title: Criticality and Quench Dynamics at the Anderson Transition of a Chern Insulator
papers.abstract: We study the critical properties of the topological Anderson phase transition in a strongly disordered Chern insulator, separating the topological phase from a trivial Anderson insulator. We show that the transition is characterized by a non-zero electrical conductance and by the emergence of a critical length scale in the real-space profile of the local Chern marker. From this, we extract the correlation-length and the dynamical critical exponents, which are consistent with those of non-interacting models of the integer quantum Hall effect. We then ramp the disorder strength across the transition and study the ensuing dynamics. In contrast to clean topological systems, we find that the excitation density does not follow the Kibble-Zurek scaling. The non-equilibrium length scale associated with the local Chern marker is decoupled from the generation of excitations. For studied system sizes, we find it to be close to the Kibble-Zurek prediction for the topological-to-trivial quench, while it deviates from it for the reverse direction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“we study the critical properties”、“we extract the correlation-length and the dynamical critical exponents”、“we ramp the disorder strength... and study the ensuing dynamics”，属于数值模拟和理论分析。；研究对象：强无序Chern绝缘体中的拓扑安德森相变，即从拓扑相到平凡安德森绝缘体的相变过程及其非平衡动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该拓扑安德森相变由非零电导和局域Chern标记实空间分布中的临界长度标度表征，其临界指数与整数量子霍尔效应的无相互作用模型一致；但淬火动力学中激发密度不遵循Kibble-Zurek标度，且非平衡长度尺度与激发产生解耦。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该拓扑安德森相变由非零电导和局域Chern标记实空间分布中的临界长度标度表征，其临界指数与整数量子霍尔效应的无相互作用模型一致；但淬火动力学中激发密度不遵循Kibble-Zurek标度，且非平衡长度尺度与激发产生解耦。；创新点：首次在强无序Chern绝缘体的拓扑安德森相变中系统研究了淬火动力学，发现其偏离Kibble-Zurek标度，并揭示了局域Chern标记的非平衡长度尺度与激发产生之间的解耦现象。
papers.method_zh: 通过计算电导、局域Chern标记的实空间分布提取关联长度和动力学临界指数；通过改变无序强度跨越相变进行淬火动力学模拟，分析激发密度和非平衡长度尺度的标度行为。

papers.title: Quantum annealing for materials
papers.abstract: Finding the global minimum of a potential energy surface is a fundamental challenge in materials science, with applications ranging from protein folding to cluster physics and, more broadly, to systems in which the number of (meta)stable configurations grows prohibitively large. In recent decades, quantum annealing (QA) has emerged as a promising global optimization strategy, exploiting quantum fluctuations in contrast to the thermal fluctuations that drive its classical counterpart. Here, we introduce a novel implementation of QA based on path-integral molecular dynamics, an efficient and well-established framework for sampling the quantum nuclear density without the need to manipulate many-body wavefunctions explicitly. While retaining the flexibility and simplicity of molecular dynamics simulations, this quantum-annealing protocol delivers strong performance across a wide range of atomic systems, simulated by either empirical force fields or machine-learning interatomic potentials. The method can be used either as a global optimizer of the potential-energy surface, or as a quantum-informed structure-search strategy in which nuclear quantum effects are included directly in the optimization workflow -- a feature particularly relevant for materials such as high-pressure hydrides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：quantum annealing (量子退火)、path-integral molecular dynamics (路径积分分子动力学)、global optimization (全局优化)。；研究对象：材料科学中的势能面全局最小值问题，具体应用于原子团簇、高压氢化物等具有大量（亚）稳态构型的体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于路径积分分子动力学的量子退火新实现方法，该方法既能作为势能面的全局优化器，也能作为直接包含核量子效应的量子化结构搜索策略，在多种原子体系中表现出强性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于路径积分分子动力学的量子退火新实现方法，该方法既能作为势能面的全局优化器，也能作为直接包含核量子效应的量子化结构搜索策略，在多种原子体系中表现出强性能。；创新点：将路径积分分子动力学这一成熟高效的量子核密度采样框架应用于量子退火，无需显式操控多体波函数，同时保留了分子动力学模拟的灵活性和简洁性，并首次将核量子效应直接纳入结构优化流程。
papers.method_zh: 路径积分分子动力学（path-integral molecular dynamics），结合经验力场或机器学习原子间势能（machine-learning interatomic potentials）进行模拟。

papers.title: Drag-induced skin effect in a Bose-Fermi mixture
papers.abstract: The non-Hermitian skin effect (NHSE) represents one of the most distinctive phenomena in non-Hermitian physics. Here, we uncover a new drag-induced NHSE mechanism in interacting Bose--Fermi mixtures where only bosons and not fermions experience asymmetric hoppings. %While bosons exhibit intrinsic skin localization due to asymmetric hopping, fermions remain Hermitian in isolation and do not independently support NHSE. We show that strong Bose--Fermi interactions enable fermions to inherit boundary accumulation through correlated bound states. %In the few-body regime, The interplay of interactions, quantum statistics, and non-Hermitian dynamics gives rise to an interaction-induced blockade mechanism, leading to highly asymmetric fermionic transport. We demonstrate that the drag-induced NHSE is dynamically stable and propose a feasible realization in ultracold Bose--Fermi mixtures with Floquet-engineered asymmetric tunneling. Our results establish a general interaction-mediated mechanism for emergent non-Hermitian localization in hybrid quantum matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中主要讨论理论机制（如“揭示了一种新的拖曳诱导NHSE机制”“相互作用、量子统计和非厄米动力学的相互作用”），并提出了在超冷原子体系中的可行实现方案（“提出在超冷Bose-Fermi混合物中通过Floquet工程实现”），未提及具体实验数据或数值计算细节。；研究对象：Bose-Fermi混合物中的非厄米趋肤效应（NHSE），具体为仅玻色子具有非对称跳跃、费米子保持厄米性的相互作用体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过强Bose-Fermi相互作用，费米子可以通过关联束缚态继承玻色子的边界局域化，从而产生拖曳诱导的非厄米趋肤效应；相互作用、量子统计和非厄米动力学的结合导致一种相互作用诱导的阻塞机制，使费米子输运高度不对称。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过强Bose-Fermi相互作用，费米子可以通过关联束缚态继承玻色子的边界局域化，从而产生拖曳诱导的非厄米趋肤效应；相互作用、量子统计和非厄米动力学的结合导致一种相互作用诱导的阻塞机制，使费米子输运高度不对称。；创新点：首次在Bose-Fermi混合体系中提出通过相互作用拖曳机制使原本厄米的费米子获得非厄米趋肤效应，建立了一种通用的相互作用介导的非厄米局域化机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，涉及非厄米物理、多体相互作用、量子统计效应，以及Floquet工程实现非对称隧穿（具体计算方法如少体分析、相互作用诱导阻塞机制等，摘要未明确说明具体数值或解析方法）。

papers.title: In vivo measurements of fascia lata effective mechanics combined to a memory fiber recruitment viscoelastic modeling approach
papers.abstract: The fascia lata plays a central role in force transmission and body mechanics, yet its in vivo mechanical behavior remains poorly characterized. Existing approaches -- shear wave elastography and direct force measurements alike -- share a fundamental limitation: none simultaneously captures both the elastic and viscous components of fascial mechanics within a single experiment. The primary aim of this study is therefore to develop an experimental and modeling framework that enables the reproducible measurement of the effective viscoelastic properties of the fascia lata in vivo. To this end, we combine controlled ramp-relaxation experiments on the human fascia lata with a constitutive model that integrates fiber recruitment and dual-timescale viscoelastic relaxation. We emphasize that this is an effective model: rather than describing intrinsic local material properties, it characterizes the mechanical response of the fascia lata complex including its coupling to the hip-thigh musculoskeletal system under controlled loading conditions. The model captures both the nonlinear stiffening during elongation and the dual decay of force during relaxation, using a minimal set of physically interpretable parameters. Repeated trials demonstrate good reproducibility, with parameter variability within 10%. Our results support the view that fascia lata behaves as a hierarchical, hydrated composite whose macroscopic mechanical response emerges from the coupled effects of collagen alignment, matrix viscoelasticity, and fluid flow. This work provides a quantitative foundation for future in vivo investigations into how training, rehabilitation, or aging influence the evolution of fascial mechanical properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合建模）。判断依据：关键词“controlled ramp-relaxation experiments”、“constitutive model”、“in vivo measurements”。；研究对象：人体阔筋膜（fascia lata）在体（in vivo）的有效力学行为，特别是其粘弹性特性及与髋-大腿肌肉骨骼系统的耦合响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 阔筋膜在体力学响应可通过结合纤维募集和双时间尺度粘弹性松弛的唯象模型准确描述，表现为伸长过程中的非线性硬化及松弛过程中的双指数力衰减，且参数重复性良好（变异<10%）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：阔筋膜在体力学响应可通过结合纤维募集和双时间尺度粘弹性松弛的唯象模型准确描述，表现为伸长过程中的非线性硬化及松弛过程中的双指数力衰减，且参数重复性良好（变异<10%）。；创新点：首次在单一实验中同时捕获阔筋膜在体力学行为的弹性与粘性分量，并建立了结合纤维募集与双时间尺度松弛的唯象建模框架，克服了现有剪切波弹性成像或直接力测量方法无法同步获取弹性和粘性信息的局限性。
papers.method_zh: 对人体阔筋膜进行受控的斜坡-松弛（ramp-relaxation）实验，同时构建一个整合纤维募集机制与双时间尺度粘弹性松弛的本构模型。该模型为有效模型，描述的是阔筋膜复合体在受控加载条件下的整体力学响应，而非局部本征材料性质。

papers.title: Spin-wave phase modulation using magnetic domain walls in dipolarly coupled structures for non-volatile magnonic computation
papers.abstract: A controllable phase shifter is a key component for spin-wave-based logic and information processing devices. Here, we propose a domain-wall-position-controlled spin-wave phase shifter that exploits dipolar coupling between two closely spaced waveguides to enable continuous phase tuning over a range approaching 360degrees while keeping the spin-wave amplitude constant. Using micromagnetic simulations, we model a bias-free hybrid structure composed of a nanoscale waveguide magnetostatically coupled to a half-ring-shaped structure both made from bismuth-doped yttrium iron garnet with strong perpendicular magnetic anisotropy. Displacing a domain wall in the half-ring modulates the dispersion relation in the adjacent straight waveguide due to the changed magnetostatic interaction, providing a compact and dynamically reconfigurable phase-shifting mechanism. This approach offers precise and non-volatile control over spin-wave propagation and is compatible with energy-efficient magnonic logic architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Using micromagnetic simulations”（使用微磁学模拟）。；研究对象：基于磁畴壁位置调控的自旋波移相器。具体体系为由具有强垂直磁各向异性的掺铋钇铁石榴石（bismuth-doped yttrium iron garnet）制成的纳米级波导和半环形结构组成的无偏置混合结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在半环形结构中移动磁畴壁的位置，可以改变其与相邻直波导之间的静磁相互作用，从而连续调控直波导中自旋波的色散关系，实现接近360度的相位调制，且自旋波振幅保持不变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在半环形结构中移动磁畴壁的位置，可以改变其与相邻直波导之间的静磁相互作用，从而连续调控直波导中自旋波的色散关系，实现接近360度的相位调制，且自旋波振幅保持不变。；创新点：提出了一种利用磁畴壁位置控制来实现自旋波相位连续、非易失性调控的新机制。该机制结构紧凑、可动态重构，且无需外加偏置磁场，与低功耗磁子逻辑架构兼容。
papers.method_zh: 微磁学模拟（micromagnetic simulations）。具体建模了一个由纳米级波导和半环形结构组成的混合系统，两者通过静磁耦合（dipolar coupling / magnetostatic interaction）相互作用。

papers.title: Role of Characteristic Length Scale in Interface Graphitization-Induced Wear Resistance of Diamond and Amorphous Carbon
papers.abstract: The evolution of interfacial atomic structures critically influences the friction and wear behavior of carbon-based materials. However, how the characteristic length scale of friction-induced sp\textsuperscript{2} reconstruction governs macroscopic wear remains poorly understood, particularly for diamond and amorphous carbon where the interfacial graphitization modes differ fundamentally. In this work, we develop a machine learning potential for these carbon systems and investigate the structural evolution at interfaces in both diamond/diamond and amorphous/amorphous carbon systems using molecular dynamics simulations. Our results reveal distinct atomic-scale characteristics of graphitization at the two interfaces. Diamond interfaces develop a laterally continuous sp\textsuperscript{2} reconstruction layer with a characteristic length of 30--45~Å, while amorphous carbon interfaces form only fully isolated sp\textsuperscript{2} patches of 8--12~Å. This disparity in characteristic length scale determines the density of weakly bonded interfacial atoms left outside the reconstruction layer, thereby directly dictating the macroscopic wear rate. Based on these insights, we propose a strategy to regulate friction-induced graphitization in diamond coatings by protecting specific crystallographic orientations, such as the (111) close-packed planes. This work bridges the gap between atomic-scale interfacial structure and macroscopic tribological performance, offering mechanistic guidelines for the rational design of wear-resistant carbon-based coatings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine learning potential、molecular dynamics simulations。；研究对象：金刚石/金刚石界面与非晶碳/非晶碳界面在摩擦过程中界面石墨化的结构演化，以及由此决定的宏观磨损行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 金刚石界面形成横向连续的sp²重构层（特征长度30–45 Å），而非晶碳界面仅形成完全孤立的sp²斑块（8–12 Å），这种特征长度尺度的差异决定了弱键合界面原子的密度，进而直接控制宏观磨损率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：金刚石界面形成横向连续的sp²重构层（特征长度30–45 Å），而非晶碳界面仅形成完全孤立的sp²斑块（8–12 Å），这种特征长度尺度的差异决定了弱键合界面原子的密度，进而直接控制宏观磨损率。；创新点：揭示了摩擦诱导sp²重构的特征长度尺度与宏观磨损之间的定量关联，并基于此提出通过保护特定晶向（如(111)密排面）来调控金刚石涂层中摩擦诱导石墨化的策略。
papers.method_zh: 开发了针对碳体系的机器学习势（machine learning potential），并利用分子动力学模拟（molecular dynamics simulations）研究两种界面的结构演化。

papers.title: Unconventional crystallization pathway bypassing the intermediate cubic phase in phase-change superlattices
papers.abstract: The Ge-Sb-Te (GST) superlattice phase-change material is a promising candidate for overcoming the high power-consumption of phase-change memory (PCM). However, the working mechanism of the superlattice PCM remains controversial. Partial amorphization, which is currently considered the most plausible mechanism, remains hotly debated: how does the partially amorphized GST recrystallize into its superlattice phase instead of the conventionally expected cubic phase? Here, we address this issue using large-scale molecular dynamics simulations enabled by a machine-learning interatomic potential. Starting from a partially melted GST superlattice, we demonstrate that the residual crystalline regions serve as nuclei, enabling the amorphous GST to recrystallize directly into the superlattice phase without passing through the intermediate cubic phase. Moreover, the recrystallized phase is not an ideal superlattice, but rather a structurally ordered and chemically disordered defective superlattice characterized by anti-site defects and stacking faults. The defective superlattice region is also more susceptible to melting than the defect-free superlattice, and thereby can act as the active region of the PCM device. These results help to clarify the longstanding debates concerning the mechanism of superlattice-based PCM.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：大规模分子动力学模拟、机器学习原子间势。；研究对象：Ge-Sb-Te (GST) 超晶格相变材料，具体研究其部分非晶化后的再结晶路径与机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 部分熔化的GST超晶格在再结晶过程中，残余晶区作为晶核，使非晶GST直接再结晶为超晶格相，绕过了传统预期的中间立方相；再结晶相并非理想超晶格，而是具有反位缺陷和堆垛层错的结构有序但化学无序的缺陷超晶格。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：部分熔化的GST超晶格在再结晶过程中，残余晶区作为晶核，使非晶GST直接再结晶为超晶格相，绕过了传统预期的中间立方相；再结晶相并非理想超晶格，而是具有反位缺陷和堆垛层错的结构有序但化学无序的缺陷超晶格。；创新点：首次通过原子尺度模拟揭示了GST超晶格在部分非晶化后绕过中间立方相、直接再结晶为缺陷超晶格的非常规结晶路径，并指出该缺陷超晶格区域更易熔化，可作为相变存储器件的活性区域，从而澄清了超晶格相变存储器工作机制中长期存在的争议。
papers.method_zh: 基于机器学习原子间势（machine-learning interatomic potential）的大规模分子动力学模拟。

papers.title: A proof of an identity for the critical exponents of jamming
papers.abstract: Within the full replica-symmetry-breaking (fullRSB) solution of dense hard spheres in infinite dimension, Charbonneau, Kurchan, Parisi, Urbani, and Zamponi (CKPUZ; J.Stat.Mech.P10009, 2014) introduced three critical exponents $a$, $b$, $c$ governing the matching region of the fullRSB profile near the jamming transition. These exponents satisfy two scaling relations. The first, $b=(1+c)/2$, was established analytically by the diffusion-drift balance in the scaling ansatz. The second, $a+b=1$, was observed numerically to arbitrary precision but could not be proven. The exponents $a,b,c$ of the scaling fullRSB ansatz are related to the physical exponents $α, θ, κ$ that control the gap, force, and overlap distributions by the relations $α=a/b$, $θ=(c-a)/(b-c)$, $κ=c+1$. Crucially, the relation $a+b=1$ yields the scaling relations $α=1/(2+θ)$ and $κ=2-2/(3+θ)$ predicted on independent grounds by the mechanical-marginal-stability arguments of Wyart and collaborators. Here, we give an analytic proof of the identity $a+b=1$ from the scaling fullRSB equations. The proof was obtained through interaction with Claude (Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.7) and verified by us.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：full replica-symmetry-breaking solution、scaling relations、analytic proof、scaling fullRSB equations。；研究对象：高维稠密硬球体系在堵塞转变（jamming transition）附近的临界行为，具体为fullRSB解中的三个临界指数a、b、c及其满足的标度关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 给出了标度关系a+b=1的解析证明，该关系此前仅被数值验证到任意精度但未能证明。这一证明使得堵塞转变的临界指数α、θ、κ之间的标度关系（α=1/(2+θ)和κ=2-2/(3+θ)）得以从fullRSB方程中严格导出。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：给出了标度关系a+b=1的解析证明，该关系此前仅被数值验证到任意精度但未能证明。这一证明使得堵塞转变的临界指数α、θ、κ之间的标度关系（α=1/(2+θ)和κ=2-2/(3+θ)）得以从fullRSB方程中严格导出。；创新点：首次从fullRSB标度方程解析证明了此前仅被数值观测到的恒等式a+b=1，从而将机械边际稳定性论证与fullRSB理论框架下的临界指数关系严格统一。
papers.method_zh: 基于Charbonneau等人提出的fullRSB标度方程，通过解析推导（与Claude模型交互获得思路并验证）证明指数恒等式a+b=1。

papers.title: Stress-triggered atomic explosion of trapped hydrogen initiates crack nucleation
papers.abstract: Hydrogen embrittlement (HE) has persisted for more than a century as one of the most intractable problems in materials science. The prevailing view1 that diffusive H governs embrittlement has fostered the widespread assumption that H trapping at crystal defects mitigates HE. Here we overturn this conventional paradigm. Using plasma/ion irradiation of tungsten, we decouple -- for the first time -- H-induced crack nucleation from subsequent cavity propagation, and reveal nucleation as a two-stage mechanochemical fracture instability enabled by trapped H in the absence of diffusive H. In the first stage, H accumulation to a critical occupancy at dislocation cores acts as a chemical fuse, collapsing the local cohesive strength to a threshold at which infinitesimal external loads can trigger atomic decohesion. This bond rupture instantaneously enables the second stage: confined recombination of atomic hydrogen into molecular form. The abrupt release of chemical energy within an atomically restricted volume generates a transient inflation pressure that drives a dynamic, brittle jump to an internal macroscopic cavity. By separating mechanical decohesion triggering from energetic crack driving, our results provide a deterministic framework for the onset of H-induced crack nucleation under low-stress conditions. Furthermore, we place experimentally the classical H-enhanced decohesion model on an atomistic foundation and elevate it from phenomenology to prediction. Finally, by shifting the focus from experimentally elusive diffusive H to directly measurable trapped H, this work reframes HE as a deterministic, quantifiable instability, establishing a new paradigm for understanding and mitigating H-induced failure in high-strength metals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：plasma/ion irradiation of tungsten、decouple、experimentally place）；研究对象：氢致裂纹成核现象，具体材料为钨（tungsten），涉及氢脆（hydrogen embrittlement）中的机械化学断裂不稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无扩散氢参与的条件下，位错核心处捕获的氢原子达到临界占据数后，会引发局部原子键断裂，随后氢原子在受限空间内复合为分子，释放的化学能产生瞬态膨胀压力，驱动裂纹成核并扩展为宏观空腔。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无扩散氢参与的条件下，位错核心处捕获的氢原子达到临界占据数后，会引发局部原子键断裂，随后氢原子在受限空间内复合为分子，释放的化学能产生瞬态膨胀压力，驱动裂纹成核并扩展为宏观空腔。；创新点：颠覆了传统认为扩散氢主导氢脆、缺陷捕获氢可缓解氢脆的范式，首次将氢致裂纹成核归因于捕获氢而非扩散氢，并将氢增强脱聚模型从现象学提升至原子尺度的可预测框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用等离子体/离子辐照钨样品，通过控制实验条件将氢致裂纹成核与后续空腔扩展过程解耦，并结合原子尺度分析验证经典氢增强脱聚模型。

papers.title: Magneto-optical evidence for single-crystal-like magnetic switching of epitaxial antiferromagnetic LaFeO3 films
papers.abstract: Strained epitaxial films of the antiferromagnetic orthoferrite LaFeO3 offer a promising platform for antiferromagnetic spintronics, yet their magnetic switching behavior and domain structure have remained largely unexplored due to the small magnitude of the weak ferromagnetic moment. Here, we demonstrate that longitudinal magneto-optical Kerr effect (MOKE) measurements provide a sensitive and direct probe of magnetic switching and domain processes in coherently strained LaFeO3 thin films grown on orthorhombic substrates. By employing DyScO3(110), GdScO3(110), and NdGaO3(110) substrates, we achieve straincontrolled, largely twin-free growth and identify the orientation of the orthorhombic c-axis through the presence or absence of a longitudinal MOKE signal. Compressively strained films exhibit large Kerr signals, rectangular hysteresis loops, and magnetic single-domain remanence over macroscopic areas. Tensile strain on orthorhombic substrates is associated with two competing structural effects on thin film orientation; in-plane magnetization has been identified in some films on GdScO3(110) by MOKE. Angle-dependent MOKE hysteresis follows the Kondorsky model, indicating domain-wall-controlled switching analogous to bulk single crystals. Kerr microscopy reveals abrupt domain nucleation and rapid domain-wall motion, with defects acting as pinning centers and governing the coercive field. Our results establish MOKE as an efficient optical tool for identifying orthorhombic orientation, probing magnetic switching of coupled weak magnetization and Neel vectors, and accessing domain dynamics in LaFeO3 films. This provides a foundation for strain-engineered orthoferrite thin films in antiferromagnetic spintronics and magnonics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：magneto-optical Kerr effect (MOKE) measurements、Kerr microscopy、epitaxial films。；研究对象：外延生长的反铁磁正交铁氧体LaFeO₃薄膜，具体研究其磁化翻转行为、磁畴结构以及弱铁磁矩的探测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纵向磁光克尔效应（MOKE）可灵敏、直接地探测相干应变LaFeO₃薄膜的磁化翻转和磁畴过程；压应变薄膜表现出大克尔信号、矩形磁滞回线和宏观单畴剩磁，其磁化翻转由畴壁运动控制，类似于块体单晶。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纵向磁光克尔效应（MOKE）可灵敏、直接地探测相干应变LaFeO₃薄膜的磁化翻转和磁畴过程；压应变薄膜表现出大克尔信号、矩形磁滞回线和宏观单畴剩磁，其磁化翻转由畴壁运动控制，类似于块体单晶。；创新点：首次利用MOKE作为光学工具，实现对反铁磁LaFeO₃薄膜中正交晶系c轴取向的识别、弱磁化与奈尔矢量的耦合翻转探测以及磁畴动力学的直接观测，为应变工程调控正交铁氧体薄膜在反铁磁自旋电子学和磁振子学中的应用奠定了基础。
papers.method_zh: 采用分子束外延（或类似薄膜生长技术，摘要未明确说明具体生长方法）在DyScO₃(110)、GdScO₃(110)和NdGaO₃(110)衬底上生长LaFeO₃薄膜；利用纵向MOKE测量、角度依赖MOKE磁滞回线（Kondorsky模型分析）以及克尔显微镜进行表征。

papers.title: Tailoring pure valley-Zeeman spin-orbit coupling in WSe$_2$-encapsulated monolayer graphene
papers.abstract: Engineering proximity effects in twisted van der Waals heterostructures offers a powerful platform for designing electronic properties. While theoretical predictions of quantum interference in transition metal dichalcogenide-encapsulated graphene can selectively control the spin-orbit coupling component, experimental realizations have remained elusive. Here, we report pure valley-Zeeman spin-orbit coupling in monolayer graphene, achieved by encapsulation between two parallel twisted WSe$_2$ monolayers. We observed a symmetry-enforced reordering of Landau levels, which is driven by the competition between the fixed valley-Zeeman energy and the magnetic-field-dependent cyclotron energy. This reordering is characterized by a transition from symmetry-broken states in the quantum Hall effect to a restored fourfold degeneracy with integer or half-integer quantum Hall sequences. We also demonstrate the ability to completely quench the proximity spin-orbit coupling by tuning the encapsulated geometry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“我们观察到”（observed）、“我们展示”（demonstrate）等实验性描述，涉及量子霍尔效应中的朗道能级重排和对称性破缺态的实验观测。；研究对象：WSe₂封装单层石墨烯异质结，具体为两个平行扭转的WSe₂单层之间夹单层石墨烯的范德华异质结构，研究其中的纯谷-塞曼自旋轨道耦合效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在两个平行扭转的WSe₂单层之间封装单层石墨烯，实现了纯谷-塞曼型自旋轨道耦合，并观察到由谷-塞曼能与磁场依赖的回旋能竞争驱动的对称性强制朗道能级重排，表现为量子霍尔效应中从对称性破缺态到四重简并态的转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在两个平行扭转的WSe₂单层之间封装单层石墨烯，实现了纯谷-塞曼型自旋轨道耦合，并观察到由谷-塞曼能与磁场依赖的回旋能竞争驱动的对称性强制朗道能级重排，表现为量子霍尔效应中从对称性破缺态到四重简并态的转变。；创新点：首次实验实现了过渡金属硫族化合物封装石墨烯中纯谷-塞曼自旋轨道耦合的选择性控制，并展示了通过调节封装几何构型完全抑制近邻自旋轨道耦合的能力。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用扭转范德华异质结构筑技术，通过封装几何构型调控近邻效应，结合量子霍尔输运测量观测朗道能级重排和简并度变化。

papers.title: Monte-Carlo study of Compositional Heterogeneity in Multicomponent Cluster Crystals
papers.abstract: Soft (sub)micron-sized particles with bounded interactions can form cluster crystals, periodic structures in which multiple particles occupy the same lattice site. While the thermodynamics of monodisperse cluster crystals is well understood, less is known about how compositional disorder affects their stability. Using Monte Carlo simulations and density functional theory we show that binary cluster crystals undergo a density driven transition from a homogeneous mixed state to a heterogeneous ``alloy" like solid in which lattice sites spontaneously differentiate into populations with distinct compositions and occupancies while preserving the underlying crystal symmetry. The transition is accompanied by a sharp increase in the equilibrium lattice site density and by increased compositional fluctuations, but we see no evidence for macroscopic phase separation. We demonstrate that this transition is governed by competition between clustering and demixing instabilities and derive a simple scaling law for the demixing density as a function of temperature, composition, and particle size mismatch, in quantitative agreement with simulation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合文章。判断依据：Monte Carlo simulations、density functional theory。；研究对象：多组分团簇晶体中的成分异质性（compositional heterogeneity），具体为二元团簇晶体从均匀混合态到非均匀“合金”类固体的密度驱动转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 二元团簇晶体在密度驱动下会发生从均匀混合态到异质“合金”态的转变，其中晶格位点自发分化为具有不同成分和占据数的群体，但保持晶体对称性不变；该转变由团簇化与去混合不稳定性之间的竞争主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：二元团簇晶体在密度驱动下会发生从均匀混合态到异质“合金”态的转变，其中晶格位点自发分化为具有不同成分和占据数的群体，但保持晶体对称性不变；该转变由团簇化与去混合不稳定性之间的竞争主导。；创新点：揭示了二元团簇晶体中一种新的成分异质性转变，并推导出描述去混合密度随温度、成分和粒子尺寸失配变化的简单标度律，与模拟结果定量一致。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 蒙特卡洛模拟（Monte Carlo simulations）和密度泛函理论（density functional theory）。

papers.title: Geometric Bounds on the Finite-Time Performance of Active Machines
papers.abstract: Optimizing energy conversion in active matter remains a central challenge in nonequilibrium physics. Here, we develop a unified thermodynamic framework that characterizes the finite-time performance of interacting active machines. We show that cyclic work admits a geometric decomposition into an antisymmetric thermodynamic curvature, governing work extraction, and a symmetric metric, controlling dissipation. Minimal-dissipation protocols follow geodesics in parameter space, while optimal work extraction deviates from them due to a curvature-induced, Lorentz-like effect. This geometric structure directly determines the finite-time scaling of work and dissipation, enabling a mapping onto Onsager-type quasi-linear current--force relations. We show that both the maximal efficiency and the efficiency at maximum power are governed by an asymmetry parameter and a figure of merit, establishing a formal correspondence between active machines and thermoelectric devices with broken time-reversal symmetry. Our results reveal a fundamental geometric origin of energy-conversion performance and provide a general framework for optimizing active machines.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：thermodynamic framework、geometric decomposition、mapping onto Onsager-type relations。；研究对象：活性物质中相互作用的主动机器（active machines）在有限时间内的能量转换性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 主动机器的循环功可分解为反对称热力学曲率（控制功提取）和对称度量（控制耗散），最优效率与最大功率效率由不对称参数和品质因子决定，建立了主动机器与时间反演对称破缺热电装置之间的形式对应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：主动机器的循环功可分解为反对称热力学曲率（控制功提取）和对称度量（控制耗散），最优效率与最大功率效率由不对称参数和品质因子决定，建立了主动机器与时间反演对称破缺热电装置之间的形式对应。；创新点：揭示了主动机器能量转换性能的几何起源，并建立了与热电装置的形式对应关系，为优化主动机器提供了通用框架。
papers.method_zh: 构建统一热力学框架，利用参数空间中的几何结构（曲率与度量）分析有限时间性能，推导出准线性流-力关系，并映射到Onsager型输运理论。

papers.title: Generation and time evolution of anomalous Floquet Majorana flat edge modes in two-dimensional noncolinear magnet-superconductor heterostructures
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate the realization of gapless Floquet topological superconducting phases in a two-dimensional magnet-superconductor heterostructure (2D Shiba lattice) in the presence of a harmonic drive implemented in the chemical potential. Employing a real-space tight-binding model, we obtain both the regular $0$- and anomalous $π$-Floquet Majorana flat edge modes (FMFEMs) in the quasi-energy spectrum. We also study the real-time evolution of the FMFEMs and analyze their local density of states in the presence of such a periodic drive. The topological characterization is performed using the winding number, exploiting the chiral symmetry of the equivalent bulk effective momentum-space Hamiltonian. This is also supported by the corresponding edge state spectra. Furthermore, we employ the Brillouin-Wigner (BW) and Floquet perturbation theory (FPT) to gain analytical insight into the problem. We compare our exact (numerical), BW, and FPT results in terms of the quasi-energy spectra obtained across different frequency regimes. We find good agreement between the exact numerical, BW, and FPT results in the higher-frequency and high-amplitude domain, particularly close to the $0$-quasi-energy modes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。关键词：theoretically investigate、real-space tight-binding model、exact (numerical)、Brillouin-Wigner (BW)、Floquet perturbation theory (FPT)。；研究对象：二维非共线磁体-超导体异质结（2D Shiba lattice）中，在化学势受到周期驱动（harmonic drive）下的Floquet拓扑超导相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在准能量谱中同时实现了常规的0-和反常的π-Floquet马约拉纳平边缘模（FMFEMs），并研究了其在周期驱动下的实时演化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在准能量谱中同时实现了常规的0-和反常的π-Floquet马约拉纳平边缘模（FMFEMs），并研究了其在周期驱动下的实时演化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用实空间紧束缚模型进行数值计算，利用手征对称性下的缠绕数（winding number）进行拓扑表征，并结合Brillouin-Wigner（BW）微扰理论和Floquet微扰理论（FPT）进行解析分析，与精确数值结果在不同频率区间进行对比。

papers.title: Many-Body Non-Hermitian Physics in the Generalized Brillouin Zone
papers.abstract: The breakdown of conventional bulk-boundary correspondence (BBC) in non-Hermitian system can be resolved by the generalized Brillouin zone (GBZ) theory. However, extending the GBZ theory to interacting many-body systems remains an open problem. Here, we consider an interacting non-Hermitian model characterized by a circular GBZ. We show that, based on a GBZ transformation, a quasi-reciprocal many-body Hamiltonian can be constructed which, under periodic boundary conditions (PBC), captures the physics of the original non-Hermitian model under open boundary conditions (OBC). Using exact diagonalization (ED), we determine the phase diagram for the quasi-reciprocal many-body Hamiltonian by computing the Zak phase and the structure factor of the charge-density-wave (CDW) phase. We further investigate the entanglement properties and find that the degeneracy of the low-lying entanglement spectrum characterizes each phase in the phase diagram. These findings demonstrate that the topological properties in interacting non-Hermitian system is encoded in the entanglement spectrum of the quasi-reciprocal model. Our work establishes a route to studying many-body non-Hermitian physics within the GBZ formalism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：GBZ理论、准互易多体哈密顿量、精确对角化（ED）。；研究对象：非厄米多体相互作用系统，具体为一个具有圆形广义布里渊区（GBZ）的相互作用非厄米模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过GBZ变换构造的准互易多体哈密顿量，在周期性边界条件下能捕捉原非厄米模型在开边界条件下的物理性质；相互作用非厄米系统的拓扑性质编码在准互易模型的纠缠谱中。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过GBZ变换构造的准互易多体哈密顿量，在周期性边界条件下能捕捉原非厄米模型在开边界条件下的物理性质；相互作用非厄米系统的拓扑性质编码在准互易模型的纠缠谱中。；创新点：将原本适用于单粒子非厄米系统的GBZ理论推广到相互作用多体系统，并建立了通过准互易模型纠缠谱研究非厄米多体拓扑性质的途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用广义布里渊区（GBZ）理论进行变换，构造准互易多体哈密顿量；使用精确对角化（ED）计算Zak相位和电荷密度波（CDW）相的结构因子，并分析纠缠谱的简并性。

papers.title: High-Throughput Discovery of Semimetallic Borophenes with Diverse Dirac States Via Transferable Tight-Binding Approach
papers.abstract: Borophene has attracted extensive interest due to its structural flexibility and emergent topological electronic states. However, semimetallic borophenes hosting robust Dirac states remain rare among the large number of predicted allotropes. Here, we develop a transferable tight-binding framework for planar borophenes and combine it with a graph- and group-theory-based random generation strategy to perform high-throughput screening of 522 borophene candidates. Eight previously unreported semimetallic borophenes are identified, hosting diverse topological band crossings, including type-I and type-III Dirac cones, Dirac nodal lines, and quadratic nodal points. Notably, quadratic nodal-point semimetals are predicted in borophene for the first time. Symmetry analysis reveals crystalline-symmetry-protected Dirac states, while first-principles calculations confirm their dynamical and thermal stability. These findings establish borophene as a versatile platform for engineering emergent Dirac physics in two dimensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：tight-binding framework、first-principles calculations、high-throughput screening。；研究对象：硼烯（borophene）中的半金属相及其多样化的狄拉克态，包括I型和III型狄拉克锥、狄拉克节线以及二次节点。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过高通量筛选，从522种硼烯同素异形体中发现了8种此前未报道的半金属硼烯，它们具有多种拓扑能带交叉，并首次在硼烯中预言了二次节点半金属。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过高通量筛选，从522种硼烯同素异形体中发现了8种此前未报道的半金属硼烯，它们具有多种拓扑能带交叉，并首次在硼烯中预言了二次节点半金属。；创新点：首次在硼烯中预测了二次节点半金属（quadratic nodal-point semimetals），并系统揭示了由晶体对称性保护的多种狄拉克态。
papers.method_zh: 开发了可迁移的紧束缚（tight-binding）框架，结合基于图论和群论的随机生成策略，进行高通量筛选；采用第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）验证动力学和热稳定性。

papers.title: Multiferroicity in the two-dimensional limit in hexagonal LuFeO3 films
papers.abstract: Multiferroic oxides, which combine coupled ferroelectric and magnetic orders, are central to understanding correlated quantum phenomena. Yet, as thickness approaches the two-dimensional (2D) limit, both ferroelectricity and magnetism are conventionally expected to vanish due to depolarization fields and finite-size effects, respectively. Here, we demonstrate that hexagonal LuFeO3 (h-LuFeO3) retains coupled ferroelectricity and magnetism at the 2D limit, with a thickness of just one and a half unit cells. Remarkably, the ferroelectric polarization remains comparable to bulk values at room temperature, while long-range magnetism and magnetoelectric coupling persist at low temperatures. We further show that the K3 phonon mode, which mediates the polarization-magnetism coupling, is stable down to the 2D limit. Our results establish h-LuFeO3 as the first oxide system to exhibit genuine 2D-limit multiferroicity, providing a fundamental breakthrough in the long-standing quest to understand and control coupled ferroic orders at the atomic scale.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：demonstrate、films、measurements（摘要中提及厚度、极化、磁性等实验可测物理量，暗示实验手段）。；研究对象：六方LuFeO₃（h-LuFeO₃）薄膜在二维极限下的多铁性行为，具体为厚度仅1.5个单胞的薄膜体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: h-LuFeO₃在二维极限（1.5个单胞厚度）下仍保持耦合的铁电性和磁性，室温铁电极化与体材料相当，低温下存在长程磁性和磁电耦合，成为首个展现真正二维极限多铁性的氧化物体系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：h-LuFeO₃在二维极限（1.5个单胞厚度）下仍保持耦合的铁电性和磁性，室温铁电极化与体材料相当，低温下存在长程磁性和磁电耦合，成为首个展现真正二维极限多铁性的氧化物体系。；创新点：首次在氧化物体系中实现并证实二维极限下的多铁性（同时保留铁电、磁性和磁电耦合），突破了传统认为铁电性因退极化场消失、磁性因有限尺寸效应消失的预期。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段，但提及对铁电极化、长程磁性、磁电耦合以及K₃声子模式的测量与表征，暗示可能采用压电力显微镜、磁测量、非弹性散射或光谱学等实验技术。

papers.title: Observation of interaction-induced fast Thouless pumping of solitons
papers.abstract: Thouless pumping provides a paradigmatic platform for studying the effects of interactions on topological transport in periodically driven systems. However, most studies have been constrained by adiabatic conditions, which preclude exploration of interaction-driven novel topological states at high driving frequencies. Here, we experimentally investigate the interplay between interaction and modulation frequency in Thouless pumping realized in a periodically modulated lattice in momentum space of atomic Bose-Einstein condensate. We observe fast Thouless pumping of matterwave solitons at intermediate interactions, with no counterpart in the non- or weakly interacting regimes. Beyond the boundary of topological phase transition induced by interaction, nonadiabatic quantized pumping of solitons emerges at high modulation frequencies over a broad interaction range, in good agreement with theoretical calculations, while the solitons remain trapped in the low-frequency adiabatic pumping regime. Our work opens new avenues for accelerating topological transport in driven quantum systems and engineering fast topological devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：experimentally investigate、observation、atomic Bose-Einstein condensate）；研究对象：在动量空间周期调制晶格中实现的Thouless泵浦，具体为原子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中的物质波孤子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中等相互作用强度下，观测到孤子的快速Thouless泵浦，该现象在无相互作用或弱相互作用区域不存在；在相互作用诱导的拓扑相变边界之外，高调制频率下出现非绝热量子化泵浦，而低频绝热泵浦区孤子被束缚。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中等相互作用强度下，观测到孤子的快速Thouless泵浦，该现象在无相互作用或弱相互作用区域不存在；在相互作用诱导的拓扑相变边界之外，高调制频率下出现非绝热量子化泵浦，而低频绝热泵浦区孤子被束缚。；创新点：突破了传统Thouless泵浦的绝热条件限制，在高速调制频率下发现了由相互作用驱动的非绝热量子化孤子泵浦，为加速拓扑输运和设计快速拓扑器件开辟了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 利用原子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体在动量空间中的周期调制晶格，通过调节相互作用强度和调制频率，实验观测孤子的Thouless泵浦行为，并与理论计算结果进行对比。

papers.title: Geometric aspects of spin transport in magnetic multilayers
papers.abstract: We discuss spin-dependent transfer-matrix formalism applied to magnetic multilayers in geometric terms. Starting from the stationary Schrödinger equation rewritten as a first-order spatial evolution problem, we interpret the transfer matrix as a path-ordered exponential and relate its matching-matrix construction to a noncompact group constraint. We thenconnect the induced Möbius action on reflection matrices to an Iwasawa decomposition, identify Weyl-chamber variables as the minimal noncompact transport invariants, and show how torque-related spin structures arise from compact-sector and commutator contributions. A sequence of multilayer examples illustrates the transition from pure spin filtering to controlled spin-orbit mixing and the resulting deformation of Weyl-chamber trajectories. We finally comment on the extension to higher-dimensional internal spaces relevant to orbital transport and realistic calculations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：spin-dependent transfer-matrix formalism、geometric terms、stationary Schrödinger equation、Iwasawa decomposition。；研究对象：磁性多层膜中的自旋输运现象，具体涉及自旋相关的转移矩阵及其几何结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将转移矩阵解释为路径有序指数，并引入非紧致群约束、Möbius变换、Iwasawa分解等几何概念，揭示了自旋输运中Weyl-室变量作为最小非紧致输运不变量，以及扭矩相关自旋结构来源于紧致部分和交换子贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将转移矩阵解释为路径有序指数，并引入非紧致群约束、Möbius变换、Iwasawa分解等几何概念，揭示了自旋输运中Weyl-室变量作为最小非紧致输运不变量，以及扭矩相关自旋结构来源于紧致部分和交换子贡献。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于定态薛定谔方程改写为一阶空间演化问题，采用自旋依赖的转移矩阵形式，结合路径有序指数、匹配矩阵构造、非紧致群约束、Möbius作用、Iwasawa分解、Weyl-室变量分析等几何理论框架。

papers.title: Attractive Hopfions and Bimerons in Thin Films of Chiral Magnets: Cluster Formation and Lattice Instability in the Conical Phase
papers.abstract: We investigate the energetics, interactions, and ordering tendencies of bimerons (cholesteric fingers of the second type, CF--2) and hopfions in thin films of chiral magnets and chiral liquid crystals hosting a conical background state. Although isolated bimerons possess positive eigen-energy with respect to the conical phase, they develop an attractive interaction mediated by the restructuring and partial overlap of their positive-energy shells, i.e., intermediate regions formed relative to the conical state. This attraction promotes the formation of bound pairs and extended bimeron chains, even in parameter regimes where a periodic bimeron lattice is no longer thermodynamically stable. Extending the analysis to three dimensions, we show that circularization of bimerons into hopfions renders their energy finite and gives rise to a well-defined metastability window closely linked to the stability range of cholesteric fingers. Isolated hopfions likewise exhibit an attractive interaction within the conical phase, leading to the formation of hexagonally ordered clusters. The attraction originates from the competition between favorable and unfavorable twist regions and from the energetic cost of the shell structures imposed by the conical background. Despite the presence of attractive pair potentials and cluster formation, we demonstrate that hexagonal hopfion lattices do not exhibit an equilibrium lattice period. Instead, the system evolves toward states in which the conical spiral or the CF--1 phase (cholesteric fingers of the first type) progressively invade the inter-soliton regions, thereby preventing crystallization. Our results reveal a regime of attraction without stable long-range order and clarify the interplay between topology, confinement, and conical-phase frustration in chiral magnet and liquid-crystal thin films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：energetics, interactions, ordering tendencies（能量学、相互作用、有序倾向），分析基于模型系统（chiral magnets, chiral liquid crystals）。；研究对象：手性磁体及手性液晶薄膜中的双半子（bimerons，即第二类胆甾相指状缺陷CF-2）和霍普夫子（hopfions），背景态为锥形相（conical phase）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在锥形相背景下，孤立双半子和霍普夫子虽具有正本征能量，但通过正能壳层的重构与部分重叠产生吸引相互作用，导致形成束缚对、链状或六角有序团簇；然而，这种吸引并不导致稳定的长程有序晶格，系统会演变为锥形螺旋或第一类胆甾相指状缺陷（CF-1）侵入孤子间区域的状态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在锥形相背景下，孤立双半子和霍普夫子虽具有正本征能量，但通过正能壳层的重构与部分重叠产生吸引相互作用，导致形成束缚对、链状或六角有序团簇；然而，这种吸引并不导致稳定的长程有序晶格，系统会演变为锥形螺旋或第一类胆甾相指状缺陷（CF-1）侵入孤子间区域的状态。；创新点：揭示了在锥形相中吸引相互作用与无稳定长程有序并存的新奇行为，阐明了拓扑结构、受限效应与锥形相挫败之间的竞争机制。摘要未突出说明与先前工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于能量学分析（energetics），研究双半子和霍普夫子的相互作用势及有序化趋势；通过比较不同构型（孤立、成对、链状、晶格）的能量，分析锥形相背景下的壳层结构效应。

papers.title: Relaxation of the Random Site Coulomb glass Model in Two Dimensions
papers.abstract: This study investigates the influence of material density, disorder in onsite energies, and localization length on relaxation dynamics within a two-dimensional random site Coulomb glass model at half-filling. To explore relaxation laws, we calculate the eigenvalue distribution of the linear dynamical matrix using mean-field approximations. Our findings indicate that the system initially undergoes rapid relaxation through energy-lowering transitions. The depletion of the single-particle density of states (DOS) near the Fermi level leads to slow relaxation, with fluctuations diminishing according to a power law. Subsequently, the system adheres to an exponential decay law after a specific period, defined as the relaxation time, which is inversely related to the minimum eigenvalue of the dynamical matrix. As the density of the system decreases, the relaxation rate slows down, resulting in an increase in the relaxation time. For a constant density and localization length, an increase in the disorder of onsite energies results in a longer relaxation time. A significant portion of the eigenvalue spectrum remains unaffected, suggesting that a reduction in localization length concurrent with increased disorder may play an equally vital role in the slow dynamics observed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：关键词“mean-field approximations”（平均场近似）、“calculate the eigenvalue distribution”（计算本征值分布）。；研究对象：二维随机位点库仑玻璃模型（random site Coulomb glass model）在半填充条件下的弛豫动力学，重点考察材料密度、在位能无序和局域化长度的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 系统弛豫分为三个阶段：初始快速能量降低弛豫、单粒子态密度在费米能级附近耗尽导致的幂律慢弛豫，以及最终遵循指数衰减定律的弛豫。弛豫时间与动力学矩阵的最小本征值成反比，且随密度降低、在位能无序增加而增大。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：系统弛豫分为三个阶段：初始快速能量降低弛豫、单粒子态密度在费米能级附近耗尽导致的幂律慢弛豫，以及最终遵循指数衰减定律的弛豫。弛豫时间与动力学矩阵的最小本征值成反比，且随密度降低、在位能无序增加而增大。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用平均场近似计算线性动力学矩阵的本征值分布，通过分析本征值谱研究弛豫规律。

papers.title: Effective scatterings and universal clusters of heteronuclear ultracold mixtures in quasi-low dimensions
papers.abstract: We study the effective s-wave scattering of two heteronuclear atoms harmonically confined in quasi-low dimensions, where the atoms have unequal masses and are subject to different confinement frequencies. The resulting effective scattering parameters in low dimensions, including scattering length and effective range, are derived as functions of three-dimensional scattering parameters and confinement strengths. Using realistic Li-K and Li-Cr mixtures as examples, we further compute the binding energies of universal $(1+N)$ clusters in quasi-low dimensions using the effective scattering parameters. Our findings suggest a promising pathway for practically observing universal clusters and their associated many-body phases in low-dimensional ultracold heteronuclear systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：study、derive、compute（理论推导与计算，无实验或计算模拟细节）。；研究对象：准低维异核超冷原子混合物中的有效散射与普适团簇。具体体系包括Li-K和Li-Cr混合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导了准低维异核原子（质量不等、约束频率不同）的有效s波散射参数（散射长度和有效力程）与三维散射参数及约束强度的函数关系，并利用这些参数计算了准低维中普适(1+N)团簇的结合能，表明在低维异核超冷体系中观测普适团簇及其多体相是可行的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导了准低维异核原子（质量不等、约束频率不同）的有效s波散射参数（散射长度和有效力程）与三维散射参数及约束强度的函数关系，并利用这些参数计算了准低维中普适(1+N)团簇的结合能，表明在低维异核超冷体系中观测普适团簇及其多体相是可行的。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：从三维散射参数出发，考虑谐振约束（不同频率、不同质量），推导准低维有效散射参数；数值计算：以Li-K和Li-Cr混合物为例，计算(1+N)团簇的结合能。

papers.title: Scattering and Bound States of Two Heteronuclear Ultracold Atoms in a Quasi-Two-Dimensional Confinement
papers.abstract: We solve the two-body problem of ultracold heteronuclear atoms in a quasi-two-dimensional (quasi-2D) geometry. The quasi-2D confinement is realized by a harmonic trap along the longitudinal ($z$-) direction, with different trap frequencies for the two atoms, as in many current experiments on ultracold heteronuclear gases. As a consequence, the longitudinal center-of-mass (CoM) motion is coupled to the relative motion, which significantly complicates the two-body problem. We solve this problem exactly and derive the 2D scattering length $a_{\rm 2D}$, the 2D effective range parameter $R_{\rm 2D}$, and the bound-state energies, as functions of the $s$-wave scattering length and effective range of the two atoms in free three-dimensional (3D) space. We show that multiple 2D scattering resonances can be induced by the coupling between the longitudinal CoM and relative motion. Around these resonances, $a_{\rm 2D}$ varies rapidly with the 3D scattering parameters, while $R_{\rm 2D}$ is strongly enhanced. Since the effective pairwise interaction in quasi-2D ultracold gases is determined by i.e., the two-body scattering amplitudes and bound-state energies, our results can be used for manipulating the effective 2D interatomic interaction in quasi-2D ultracold heteronuclear gases by tuning the confinement frequencies and the 3D scattering parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：solve the two-body problem、derive、exact solution。；研究对象：准二维约束下异核超冷原子（heteronuclear ultracold atoms）的两体散射与束缚态问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纵向质心运动与相对运动的耦合可诱导多个二维散射共振，在这些共振附近二维散射长度随三维散射参数快速变化，同时二维有效力程参数显著增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纵向质心运动与相对运动的耦合可诱导多个二维散射共振，在这些共振附近二维散射长度随三维散射参数快速变化，同时二维有效力程参数显著增强。；创新点：首次严格处理了异核原子在准二维约束中因囚禁频率不同而导致的纵向质心运动与相对运动耦合问题，并揭示了该耦合对二维散射共振和有效相互作用的影响。
papers.method_zh: 精确求解准二维几何下异核超冷原子的两体问题，其中准二维约束由沿纵向（z方向）的谐振势实现，且两个原子的囚禁频率不同。推导了二维散射长度、二维有效力程参数以及束缚态能量作为三维s波散射长度和有效力程的函数。

papers.title: Second-Order Synaptic Memory using Inherent Plasticity of Moiré Superlattices
papers.abstract: Achieving synaptic functionality electronically in a single-element quantum material is a fundamental challenge, as conventional methods rely on the introduction of extrinsic charge-traps or polar components. Here, we demonstrate that twisted double bilayer graphene (tDBLG) moiré superlattices, composed purely of carbon, exhibit electronic hysteresis and plasticity in presence of twist-angle disorder. Inversion symmetry breaking at the moiré length scales also gives rise to second-order nonlinear electrical response via disorder-mediated extrinsic mechanisms. Such second-order nonlinearity is highly tunable in both sign and magnitude by varying carrier concentration and vertical displacement field. We harness the coexistence of electronic plasticity and second-order nonlinearity to realize a second-order synaptic memory device. Our findings establish strained moiré carbon systems as a powerful new platform for energy-efficient neuromorphic computing, demonstrating that complex electronic functionality can emerge purely from symmetry breaking physics in a single-element material.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“demonstrate”、“exhibit”、“harness”等描述实验观测和实现的动词，并提及了通过调控载流子浓度和位移场实现可调性。；研究对象：扭曲双层石墨烯（twisted double bilayer graphene, tDBLG）莫尔超晶格。具体研究其固有的电子滞回（hysteresis）和可塑性（plasticity），以及由此产生的二阶非线性电学响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在仅由碳元素组成的扭曲双层石墨烯莫尔超晶格中，由于转角无序（twist-angle disorder）和莫尔尺度上的反演对称性破缺，可以同时实现电子突触可塑性和高度可调的二阶非线性电学响应，并基于此构建了二阶突触记忆器件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在仅由碳元素组成的扭曲双层石墨烯莫尔超晶格中，由于转角无序（twist-angle disorder）和莫尔尺度上的反演对称性破缺，可以同时实现电子突触可塑性和高度可调的二阶非线性电学响应，并基于此构建了二阶突触记忆器件。；创新点：在单一元素（碳）的量子材料中，无需引入外来的电荷陷阱或极性组分，仅利用莫尔超晶格固有的对称性破缺物理（反演对称性破缺和转角无序）来实现复杂的突触电子功能（可塑性与二阶非线性共存），为低功耗神经形态计算提供了全新的材料平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验上通过制备扭曲双层石墨烯器件，测量其电学输运特性，观察由转角无序引起的电子滞回和可塑性。通过改变载流子浓度和垂直位移场，系统地表征了二阶非线性响应的符号和幅度变化，并最终演示了二阶突触记忆功能。

papers.title: Fast Tensor Network Imaginary Time Evolution by Implicit Stepping on Logarithmic Grids
papers.abstract: We present a new method for the efficient imaginary time evolution of quantum many-body wavefunctions represented by matrix product states (MPS). We first show that logarithmic time grids are sufficient to resolve long imaginary time dynamics, yielding an exponential reduction in the number of time steps compared with standard approaches. We then show that A-stable implicit time-stepping methods for ordinary differential equations allow stable propagation for any time step size. The resulting scheme requires only matrix-vector products and linear solves, standard operations in the MPS toolbox. We validate our approach with two examples: a Heisenberg spin chain, which we use to demonstrate a speedup of several orders of magnitude over the standard time-dependent variational principle method with uniform time steps, and a single-site Anderson impurity model with a metallic bath, for which propagation to large imaginary times allows one to observe the exponential dependence of the Kondo temperature on the interaction strength.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：matrix product states (MPS)、imaginary time evolution、ordinary differential equations、time-dependent variational principle。；研究对象：量子多体波函数的虚时演化，具体验证体系包括：Heisenberg自旋链（一维量子磁体）和单杂质Anderson模型（量子杂质系统）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 采用对数时间网格结合A-稳定隐式时间步进方法，可在保持精度的前提下将虚时演化步数指数级减少，并在Heisenberg链中实现比标准均匀时间步进方法快数个数量级的加速。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：采用对数时间网格结合A-稳定隐式时间步进方法，可在保持精度的前提下将虚时演化步数指数级减少，并在Heisenberg链中实现比标准均匀时间步进方法快数个数量级的加速。；创新点：首次将对数时间网格与A-稳定隐式步进结合用于MPS虚时演化，解决了传统均匀时间步进方法在长时演化中步数过多的问题，并实现了任意大步长下的稳定传播。
papers.method_zh: 基于矩阵乘积态（MPS）的虚时演化算法，核心创新在于：1）使用对数时间网格替代均匀网格；2）采用A-稳定的隐式时间步进方法（如隐式欧拉或Crank-Nicolson）求解微分方程，仅需矩阵-向量乘积和线性求解等MPS标准操作。

papers.title: Negative temperature coefficient of Gilbert damping in magnetic bilayers
papers.abstract: The Gilbert damping of magnetic materials is an important magnetic parameter that determines the switching speed and energy dissipation of spintronic devices. In simple metals, the intrinsic Gilbert damping increases with temperature and diverges near the Curie temperature as a result of spin fluctuations. Here we present atomistic simulations and experimental measurements showing surprising and opposite behavior in Py/Nd bilayers, where the Gilbert damping decreases with increasing temperature. The effect arises because of the enhanced damping at the interface as a result of spin pumping, where elevated temperatures cause a dynamic separation of the interfacial and bulk magnetization during relaxation. Furthermore, the temperature dependence of the damping can be controlled by varying the thickness of the Nd capping layer. Our findings present a new spintronic effect that can be used to modify the dynamic properties of nanoscale materials and devices for enhanced energy efficiency or with improved switching dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“atomistic simulations and experimental measurements”。；研究对象：Py（坡莫合金）/Nd（钕）双层膜中的吉尔伯特阻尼（Gilbert damping）及其温度依赖性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Py/Nd双层膜中，吉尔伯特阻尼随温度升高而降低（负温度系数），与简单金属中阻尼随温度升高而增大的行为相反。该效应源于界面处自旋泵浦增强的阻尼，以及升温导致弛豫过程中界面与体磁化的动态分离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Py/Nd双层膜中，吉尔伯特阻尼随温度升高而降低（负温度系数），与简单金属中阻尼随温度升高而增大的行为相反。该效应源于界面处自旋泵浦增强的阻尼，以及升温导致弛豫过程中界面与体磁化的动态分离。；创新点：首次报道了磁性双层膜中吉尔伯特阻尼的负温度系数现象，并提出了一种通过界面自旋泵浦和温度诱导的磁化动态分离来解释该反常行为的新机制。该效应可用于调控纳米尺度材料和器件的动态特性。
papers.method_zh: 原子尺度模拟（atomistic simulations）与实验测量（experimental measurements）相结合。实验上通过改变Nd覆盖层厚度来调控阻尼的温度依赖性。

papers.title: Undulatory forcing of an intruder through granular media: effects of frequency and packing fraction
papers.abstract: We investigate the motion amid grains of an intruder undergoing an imposed force that oscillates with a given frequency. For that, we made use of discrete numerical simulations where the intruder was a larger disk on which a force oscillating in direction was applied, and the grains consisted of smaller disks. All disks were placed on a surface with basal friction over which they could slide, the system was confined in the sliding directions, and we varied the system packing fraction, oscillation frequency, and magnitude of the forcing. The results show intermittent and very complex motions of the intruder depending on both the packing fraction and frequency of oscillation: it can move sideways while slowly progressing forward, it can be blocked during a long period after and/or before start moving, or it can simply be blocked after a given time. Interestingly, we find that the displacement velocity is much higher when the system packing fraction is above a given threshold, contrary to intuition. The results show that there is an optimal frequency that minimizes the transit time for some ranges of packing fraction, and we propose a model based on the system elasticity that explains this behavior and agrees with the numerical simulations. Our findings shed new light on how to better explore oscillating motion to move objects within granular media.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：discrete numerical simulations）；研究对象：颗粒介质中受振荡力驱动的侵入体运动，具体为在基底摩擦表面上、由较小圆盘颗粒组成的介质中，一个较大圆盘状侵入体在方向振荡力作用下的运动行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 侵入体的位移速度在系统堆积分数高于某一阈值时反而更高，且存在一个最优振荡频率可使穿越时间最小化，该行为可由系统弹性模型解释。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：侵入体的位移速度在系统堆积分数高于某一阈值时反而更高，且存在一个最优振荡频率可使穿越时间最小化，该行为可由系统弹性模型解释。；创新点：发现了堆积分数高于阈值时侵入体速度反常增大的现象，并提出了基于系统弹性的模型来解释最优频率行为，为利用振荡运动在颗粒介质中移动物体提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 离散数值模拟（discrete numerical simulations），模拟中侵入体为受方向振荡力的大圆盘，周围为小圆盘颗粒，所有圆盘置于有基底摩擦的表面上，系统在滑动方向受限，并改变堆积分数、振荡频率和力的大小。

papers.title: Shift current conductivity in monolayer SnS: a tight-binding analysis
papers.abstract: We investigate the bulk photovoltaic effect in monolayer SnS using an effective tight-binding model derived from first-principles calculations. By comparing short-range and long-range hopping models, we show that the essential features of the shift current conductivity are captured by a minimal model. The shift current is decomposed into transition intensity and shift vector, enabling identification of dominant interband transitions. The comparison reveals that long-range hopping processes quantitatively modify the peak positions and magnitudes, while the short-range model retains the characteristic low-energy structure of the nonlinear response. Our findings provide a transparent framework for understanding and designing bulk photovoltaic effects in two-dimensional materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：tight-binding model（紧束缚模型）、first-principles calculations（第一性原理计算）、comparison of models（模型比较）。；研究对象：单层SnS（monolayer SnS）中的体光伏效应（bulk photovoltaic effect），具体为位移电流电导率（shift current conductivity）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过对比短程和长程跃迁模型，发现短程模型能够捕捉位移电流电导率的关键特征（如低能结构），而长程跃迁主要定量修正峰位和幅值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过对比短程和长程跃迁模型，发现短程模型能够捕捉位移电流电导率的关键特征（如低能结构），而长程跃迁主要定量修正峰位和幅值。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理计算构建有效紧束缚模型，分别建立短程和长程跃迁模型，并将位移电流分解为跃迁强度（transition intensity）和位移矢量（shift vector），以识别主导的带间跃迁。

papers.title: Phase transitions through excited-state level crossings and topological indicators: the case of the XXZ chain with staggered Ising interaction
papers.abstract: We combine two ways of determining the phase diagram of the spin-$1/2$ XXZ chain with a staggered Ising interaction and uniform transverse exchange, based on exact diagonalization. The model realizes a competition between Néel order and bond-dimerized phases generated by the alternating Ising interaction. The simplest approach to determine the phase boundaries is to use topological indicators based on generalized position operators. We show that in general, the bosonized and numerical results for the topological indicators agree. The second is based on crossings of excited energy levels and justified by conformal-field theory. In spite of the partial loss of translational symmetry caused by the alternating Ising interaction, we find that the latter method provides an accurate determination of the boundary between Néel and dimerized phases. Instead, while the jumps of a topological indicator provide a qualitatively correct phase diagram, its accuracy is affected when the gap is very small (or the correlation length very large) at one side of the transition, as we show using field-theoretical arguments. The combination of both methods provides a more efficient way of calculating phase diagrams for correlated one-dimensional models than other widely used conventional approaches.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：exact diagonalization（精确对角化）、bosonized（玻色化）、conformal-field theory（共形场论）、field-theoretical arguments（场论论证）。；研究对象：自旋-1/2 XXZ链，具有交错伊辛相互作用和均匀横向交换，研究其奈尔序与键二聚化相之间的竞争与相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过激发态能级交叉方法可精确确定奈尔相与二聚化相之间的边界；而基于广义位置算符的拓扑指示器在能隙极小（或关联长度极大）的一侧，其相图精度会受影响。两种方法结合比传统方法更高效地计算一维关联模型的相图。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过激发态能级交叉方法可精确确定奈尔相与二聚化相之间的边界；而基于广义位置算符的拓扑指示器在能隙极小（或关联长度极大）的一侧，其相图精度会受影响。两种方法结合比传统方法更高效地计算一维关联模型的相图。；创新点：系统比较了两种确定相图的方法（拓扑指示器与激发态能级交叉）在交错伊辛相互作用导致的平移对称性部分缺失情况下的适用性与精度，并指出拓扑指示器在特定条件下（小能隙/大关联长度）的局限性。
papers.method_zh: 基于精确对角化（exact diagonalization）进行数值计算，结合玻色化（bosonization）和共形场论（conformal-field theory）的理论分析，并使用基于广义位置算符的拓扑指示器（topological indicators）以及激发态能级交叉（crossings of excited energy levels）方法。

papers.title: The pseudogap in high-$T_c$ superconductors from SU(2) gauge symmetry and dynamic correlation effects
papers.abstract: We consider the spectral properties of the two-dimensional Hubbard model, describing the electronic properties of high-$T_c$ compounds, within the SU(2) gauge theory, which assumes the separation of electronic degrees of freedom into those of spinon and chargon subsystems. We use the dynamic mean-field theory (DMFT) approach to describe magnetic long-range order in the chargon subsystem while also treating spinon fluctuations on top of this state. We show that DMFT supplemented by long-wavelength magnetic fluctuations is essential for describing the asymmetry in the damping between the inner and outer regions of the hole pockets and the resulting formation of Fermi arcs in the underdoped regime, especially at low hole doping. The underlying hole pockets in the chargon subsystem can be associated with those observed in quantum oscillation measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：SU(2) gauge theory、dynamic mean-field theory、spinon/chargon subsystems）；研究对象：二维Hubbard模型，描述高温超导体的电子性质，具体关注赝能隙（pseudogap）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在欠掺杂区域，尤其是低空穴掺杂时，动态平均场理论（DMFT）结合长波长磁涨落对于描述空穴口袋内外区域阻尼的不对称性以及费米弧的形成至关重要。空穴口袋可关联到量子振荡测量中观察到的结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在欠掺杂区域，尤其是低空穴掺杂时，动态平均场理论（DMFT）结合长波长磁涨落对于描述空穴口袋内外区域阻尼的不对称性以及费米弧的形成至关重要。空穴口袋可关联到量子振荡测量中观察到的结果。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: SU(2)规范理论（自旋子-电荷子分离框架），动态平均场理论（DMFT）描述电荷子子系统中的磁长程序，并在此基础上处理自旋子涨落。

papers.title: Structural glasses model using disorder fields: the boson peak from local ground states
papers.abstract: We show the emergence of a contribution characteristic of the boson peak in the spectral density of structural glasses. To model the vitreous state, we consider static density-fluctuation fields coupled to a multiplicative quenched disorder. Performing an ensemble average over all disorder realizations, a functional series representation of the average free energy is obtained. In this series representation of the average free energy for the glassy state of matter, we identify in the function space effective actions. These effective actions present a large number of metastable states and ground states. Random first-order transition, widely discussed in the literature as a description of the transition from the supercooled liquid to the glassy state of matter, emerges naturally in our formalism. We establish the connection between the use of hyperbolic differential equations with random coefficients and the presence of many ground states in the average free energy. This connection allows us to study emergent excitations in such amorphous materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：模型构建、泛函级数表示、有效作用量、平均自由能。；研究对象：结构玻璃（structural glasses）中的玻色峰（boson peak）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入与乘性淬火无序耦合的静态密度涨落场来模拟玻璃态，发现平均自由能中存在大量亚稳态和基态，并由此自然产生了玻色峰在谱密度中的特征贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入与乘性淬火无序耦合的静态密度涨落场来模拟玻璃态，发现平均自由能中存在大量亚稳态和基态，并由此自然产生了玻色峰在谱密度中的特征贡献。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用静态密度涨落场与乘性淬火无序耦合的模型，通过对所有无序实现进行系综平均，得到平均自由能的泛函级数表示，并在该表示中识别出有效作用量。利用具有随机系数的双曲型微分方程与平均自由能中多个基态的存在性建立联系。

papers.title: Scaling Laws for Neural-Network Quantum States
papers.abstract: Scaling laws, the power-law relations between loss, architecture size, and compute observed in modern neural networks, offer a quantitative way to characterize the complexity of a learning problem, with the exponent governing the decay of the loss reflecting how rapidly additional resources translate into improved accuracy, and thus how hard the target is to learn. Whether an analogous framework can characterize the complexity of physical problems remains open.
